title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova said Moscow had lodged a protest with the Japanese embassy over planned joint military exercises by Japan and the United States, calling provocative military activity near Russia's eastern borders unacceptable; Iran's armed forces said they would not tolerate U.S. use of regional states' territory to attack Iran and would respond more strongly, while U.S. President Donald Trump said Iran's strikes on U.S. bases would be answered and the Pentagon announced a deal with defense contractors to boost production of Patriot and THAAD interceptors.

title_en: Special Program 'Understanding China's Governance' Book Sharing Session Airs Simultaneously on Mainstream Media in China and Kyrgyzstan
summary_en: On the occasion of Chinese President Xi Jinping's attendance at the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit and his state visit to Kyrgyzstan, a special book sharing session on the 'Xi Jinping: The Governance of China' series titled 'Understanding China's Governance' aired simultaneously on CGTN's Russian channel and Kyrgyzstan's national broadcaster. At the event, Kyrgyz Secretary of State Koichiev and other guests said Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era provides fundamental guidance for China's long-term stability and continued progress, and expressed hope that China's national rejuvenation will also inject strong momentum into Kyrgyzstan's revitalization and development.

title_en: International figures positively assess President Xi Jinping's important speech at the SCO Summit
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): International figures from multiple countries positively assessed President Xi Jinping's important speech delivered today (September 1) at the SCO Summit, saying the speech provides important guidance for improving global governance. They noted that China actively advocates multilateral cooperation and promotes dialogue and consensus among different countries, sending more positive signals to a world full of uncertainty.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo will be held in Nanning, Guangxi from September 17 to 21, that the Central Propaganda Department and 11 other departments issued a notice on organizing the 2026 "National Defense Education Month" activities in September, and that the 2026 "First Class of the New Semester" program, themed on the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, airs tonight on CCTV's comprehensive channel.

title_en: Rescue and relief work continues at full effort after mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet
summary_en: The segment reports that rescue operations in Gyirong County, Tibet, entered their seventh day, with a memorial held for victims and search, road-clearing, and monitoring work continuing, including a joint monitoring team for the barrier lake at the Gyirong port area. It also notes that China's second batch of aid supplies to Nepal departed from Shenzhen and was expected to arrive in Kathmandu that evening.

title_en: Primary and Secondary Schools and Kindergartens Nationwide Welcome the Autumn Semester
summary_en: The segment reports that schools across China are beginning the autumn semester with varied "first lessons" covering scientific exploration, safety education, and retracing the Long March route, while new education measures take effect, including continued "sunshine class placement" policies, fully rolled-out revised national curriculum textbooks, and a "learning by doing" approach in science classes. It also notes that students in disaster-affected areas such as Hengzhou in Guangxi and Shigatse in Tibet have started the new semester on schedule.

title_en: Solar Power Installed Capacity Surpasses Coal for First Time, Becoming China's Largest Power Source
summary_en: China's National Energy Administration reported that by the end of July, national solar power installed capacity reached 1.286 billion kilowatts, exceeding coal power for the first time and accounting for 31.5% of total installed capacity, making solar the country's largest power source. Solar generation in January-July reached 802.4 billion kilowatt-hours, up 15.5% year-on-year and equal to 13% of total electricity consumption, with preliminary estimates putting solar industry-related investment during the 15th Five-Year Plan period at over 2 trillion yuan.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with US-China Business Council Board Delegation
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing with a delegation from the US-China Business Council board, saying China is willing to work with the US to expand mutually beneficial cooperation and manage differences while urging the US to address China's concerns. The US side expressed confidence in China's economic prospects and said it will continue investing in China as a long-term partner.

title_en: Xi Jinping Publishes Signed Article in Egyptian Media
summary_en: On the occasion of his state visit to Cairo, President Xi Jinping published a signed article titled "Seventy Years of Standing Together Through Storms, Forging Ahead on a New Journey" in Egyptian newspapers Al-Ahram, Al-Akhbar and Al-Gomhuria, reviewing 70 years of China-Egypt relations and outlining cooperation in trade, culture and multilateral affairs. The article notes his meetings with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi and calls for deepening the comprehensive strategic partnership.

title_en: Xi Jinping Concludes Attendance at 2026 SCO Summit and State Visit to Kyrgyzstan
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): On the afternoon of September 1 local time, President Xi Jinping successfully concluded his attendance at the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit and his state visit to Kyrgyzstan. As he departed Bishkek, Kyrgyz Prime Minister Adylbek Kasymaliev and others saw him off at the airport.

title_en: Peng Liyuan Attends Spouses' Group Activity at SCO Summit
summary_en: On the morning of September 1 local time in Bishkek, Peng Liyuan, wife of President Xi Jinping, attended a spouses' group activity at the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit hosted by Aigul Japarova, wife of the Kyrgyz president. Peng Liyuan viewed an exhibition of Kyrgyz ethnic culture with the spouses of other leaders and watched a cultural performance, praising the artists and inviting Kyrgyz performers to visit China.

title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Mongolian President
summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khurelsukh on the sidelines of the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Bishkek, where Xi called for consolidating strategic mutual trust and deepening cooperation under the two countries' comprehensive strategic partnership, and Khurelsukh reaffirmed Mongolia's commitment to friendly cooperation with China and its adherence to the one-China principle. Cai Qi and Wang Yi also attended the meeting.

title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Uzbek President
summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev on the sidelines of the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Bishkek, marking ten years of the China-Uzbekistan comprehensive strategic partnership and discussing cooperation on the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, counterterrorism, and regional development.

title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Russian President
summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Bishkek, where the two leaders discussed deepening China-Russia cooperation and SCO development. Cai Qi and Wang Yi attended the meeting.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Promoting Higher-Quality Development of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The station aired a CCTV Quick Comment today (September 1) titled "Promoting Higher-Quality Development of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization."

title_en: Xi Jinping attends 'SCO Plus' meeting and delivers important speech
summary_en: On the afternoon of September 1 local time in Bishkek, President Xi Jinping attended the 'SCO Plus' meeting and delivered a speech titled 'Jointly Advocate an Equitable and Orderly Multipolar World and Realize More Just and Reasonable Global Governance,' proposing three suggestions for the SCO's role; the meeting was chaired by Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, with leaders including Belarus's Alexander Lukashenko, India's Narendra Modi, Iran's Masoud Pezeshkian, Kazakhstan's Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, Pakistan's Shehbaz Sharif, Russia's Vladimir Putin, Tajikistan's Emomali Rahmon, Uzbekistan's Shavkat Mirziyoyev, and UN Secretary-General António Guterres attending.

title_en: Xi Jinping Attends 26th Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State and Delivers Important Speech
summary_en: On September 1 in Bishkek, President Xi Jinping attended the 26th meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization Council of Heads of State, chaired by Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, with leaders including Belarus's Lukashenko, India's Modi, Iran's Pezeshkian, Kazakhstan's Tokayev, Pakistan's Sharif, Russia's Putin, Tajikistan's Rahmon and Uzbekistan's Mirziyoyev present; Xi delivered a speech titled "Promoting the Shanghai Cooperation Organization's Higher-Quality Development" proposing four points on development, security, people-to-people ties and dialogue, and the meeting adopted the Bishkek Declaration on the SCO's 25th anniversary and decided Pakistan will chair the SCO in 2026-2027.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the U.S. struck Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps mine-laying units and Iran retaliated against two U.S. air bases in Jordan; that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said conditions for restarting Russia-Ukraine talks are lacking; that Icelandic Prime Minister Kristrún Frostadóttir said her government will not pursue EU accession talks during its term; and that Japan's new 10-year government bond yield approached a 30-year high.

title_en: 2026 SCO People-to-People Exchange Event Held in Bishkek
summary_en: On the sidelines of President Xi Jinping's attendance at the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit and state visit to Kyrgyzstan, China Media Group and Kyrgyzstan's national broadcaster co-hosted a 2026 SCO people-to-people exchange event in Bishkek on August 30, where a 2026-2027 action plan for deepening media cooperation among SCO countries and a global public opinion survey on SCO influence were released, along with China-Kyrgyzstan cultural cooperation results.

title_en: Advancing the China-Kyrgyzstan community with a shared future and opening a new chapter in bilateral relations — Kyrgyzstan voices high praise for President Xi Jinping's state visit
summary_en: People from various sectors in Kyrgyzstan praised President Xi Jinping's state visit, saying the two heads of state reached important consensus on building a China-Kyrgyzstan community with a shared future and opened a new chapter in bilateral relations. International figures expressed expectations that Xi, at the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit, would advance the organization's high-quality development.

title_en: Trade-in program for consumer goods drives over 1.54 trillion yuan in sales this year
summary_en: CCTV reports that, as of August 30, the 2026 consumer goods trade-in program had driven more than 1.54 trillion yuan in related product sales, benefiting over 206 million person-times, with 27 localities running their own subsidy programs for selected categories. The segment also notes continued growth in green and smart product consumption, including high-efficiency home appliances, smart glasses, action cameras, and new energy passenger vehicles, whose market penetration rate exceeded 60% for four consecutive months.

title_en: Rescue and relief work continues after mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet
summary_en: Rescue operations continue in the core disaster area at the Gyirong port in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, with high-altitude emergency rescue helicopters airlifting personnel and supplies for deep search efforts. Crews are clearing the damaged section of National Highway 216, communications at the port have been restored, and authorities have preliminarily identified eight high-risk geological hazard points for follow-up monitoring.

title_en: China's Manufacturing Sector Sentiment Improves Notably from Last Month
summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics and the China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing reported on August 31 that China's manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index for August stood at 49.8%, up 0.6 percentage points from the previous month, with 16 of the 21 surveyed industries posting gains. Production and new orders both returned to expansion territory, while the PMIs for equipment manufacturing and high-tech manufacturing reached 51.4% and 52.9% respectively, maintaining relatively rapid growth.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang to Visit Russia for 11th Eastern Economic Forum and China-Russia Investment, Energy Cooperation Meetings
summary_en: At the invitation of the Russian federal government, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, will visit Russia from September 2 to 4 to attend the 11th Eastern Economic Forum and to hold the 13th meeting of the China-Russia Investment Cooperation Committee, the 23rd meeting of the Energy Cooperation Committee, and the 8th China-Russia Energy Business Forum.

title_en: Wang Huning Meets with President of Austria's National Council
summary_en: Wang Huning, Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, met in Beijing with Rosenkranz, President of Austria's National Council, with both sides pledging to deepen the China-Austria friendly strategic partnership and expand practical cooperation. Rosenkranz reaffirmed Austria's adherence to the one-China policy.

title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Talks with Austrian National Council President Rosenkranz
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji held talks in Beijing with Austrian National Council President Walter Rosenkranz, with both sides pledging to deepen exchanges between their legislatures and expand cooperation in trade, technology, and people-to-people ties. Rosenkranz reaffirmed Austria's one-China policy and said Austria is willing to work toward advancing EU-China relations.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs State Council executive meeting
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on August 31 to study and implement Xi Jinping's remarks on rescue and relief work following the mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet. The meeting also heard a report on urban underground pipeline construction, studied work on promoting high-quality investment attraction, and discussed and approved in principle a draft revision of the Tax Collection and Administration Law and a draft revision of the implementing regulations of the Audit Law.

title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article 'Persist in Implementing the Political Responsibility of Governing the Party and Managing Party Members'
summary_en: The 17th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on September 1, will carry a major article by Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, state president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, titled 'Persist in Implementing the Political Responsibility of Governing the Party and Managing Party Members,' an excerpt of his important expositions from June 2013 to July 2026. The article stresses that the Party must manage itself to manage it well and govern itself strictly to govern it well, and calls for a sound responsibility system with clear subjects and requirements, strict accountability, and Party committees and leading cadres at all levels, especially the 'top leaders,' to shoulder their responsibilities for Party building.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Small-Group Talks with Kyrgyz President
summary_en: On the evening of August 30, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan dined with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov and his wife Aigul Japarova at the presidential residence, and the following morning Peng Liyuan and Aigul Japarova visited the National History Museum in Bishkek and viewed cultural exhibitions.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Kyrgyz President Japarov
summary_en: On August 31 in Bishkek, Xi Jinping held talks with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, who hosted a welcome ceremony; the two leaders signed a joint declaration on developing the comprehensive strategic partnership and a treaty of permanent good-neighborliness and friendly cooperation, and witnessed the exchange of bilateral cooperation documents.

title_en: Xi Jinping attends welcome ceremony hosted by Kyrgyz President
summary_en: In Bishkek, Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov and his wife held a welcome ceremony for Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at the Ala-Archa (Harmony) Palace, including a military band playing both national anthems, a review of the honor guard, and a march-past. Xi greeted the honor guard in Kyrgyz and the two leaders watched the parade before the couples posed for a photo in front of the two national flags.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on the launch of mass production at a China-Serbia joint humanoid robot factory in Šabac, attended by Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić; Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi saying the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until the US fulfills its commitments, and Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei calling the US and Israel enemies of the region; Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reporting 38 deaths in a Russian strike on a munitions depot in Kyiv Oblast; The Guardian reporting EU gas reserves at 63%, possibly heading to a 13-year low; and Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiling a sign reaffirming the name Lake Ontario after US President Donald Trump's executive order renaming it 'Lake America.'

title_en: Kyrgyzstan figures from all sectors welcome President Xi Jinping's state visit, aiming to elevate China-Kyrgyzstan comprehensive strategic partnership in the new era to a new level
summary_en: People from various sectors in Kyrgyzstan welcomed President Xi Jinping's state visit to Kyrgyzstan, expressing hope that under the guidance of the two heads of state, the countries will deepen strategic mutual trust, expand mutually beneficial cooperation, and carry forward generations of friendship. They said the visit has strategic significance for advancing bilateral relations and will inject strong momentum into all-round cooperation and contribute to regional stability and development.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China aims to basically complete a modern agricultural product origin market system by 2030, the Ministry of Natural Resources released the country's first national geometric reference imagery covering all land territory, Xinjiang's 750kV ultra-high-voltage transmission lines surpassed 15,000 km, and Guangzhou's China-Europe freight trains have handled over 110 billion yuan in cumulative import-export value over ten years.

title_en: China Improves Multi-Tiered Medical Insurance System to Meet Diverse Coverage Needs
summary_en: China's Medical Security Law has been introduced and will take effect on January 1 next year, as the country builds a multi-tiered medical insurance network with basic medical insurance as the mainstay supported by critical illness insurance, medical assistance, commercial health insurance, charitable donations and mutual aid. The report notes that basic medical insurance has achieved near-universal coverage, and that nearly 70 million flexible-employment workers are expected to participate in employee basic medical insurance in 2025, while disadvantaged groups receive subsidized coverage under the urban-rural resident insurance scheme.

title_en: Skills training boosts employability
summary_en: CCTV reports that China has been running targeted vocational skills training aligned with industry needs, including digital training in Chongqing tied to the smart connected vehicle sector and "order-based" courses nationwide, with over 4.819 million people newly obtaining vocational qualification or skill-level certificates in the first half of the year and subsidized training planned for more than 10 million person-times for the full year.

title_en: The technological force behind 'snatching grain from the mouths of insects'
summary_en: The segment reports on China's nationwide insect radar monitoring network, the world's largest, which tracks migratory pests in real time and issues warnings 24-48 hours in advance; 65 radar units are currently connected to the national monitoring and early-warning platform, with the total expected to exceed 150 by 2030.

title_en: Technology aids field management, promoting stable grain production and increased income
summary_en: The segment reports that in late August, as autumn grain crops enter the critical yield-formation period, localities are relying on technology and smart field management to boost stable grain output and income, citing examples such as drone-based plant protection for corn in Nanyang, Henan, millimeter-wave radar-equipped drones in Guoyang, Anhui, soil-monitoring platforms in Yuncheng, Shanxi, and high-standard rice harvests in Honghe, Yunnan and Meishan, Sichuan.

title_en: Rescue and relief work for Jilong County mudslide disaster in Tibet advances effectively and in an orderly manner
summary_en: CCTV reports that as of 18:00 on the 29th the mudslide disaster in Jilong County, Shigatse, Tibet, had killed 16 people and left 546 missing, with 2,141 rescue personnel, 269 vehicles and 3,922 sets of equipment mobilized as search-and-rescue continues in the core area and the damaged National Highway 216 is being cleared. The segment also notes that China is providing a package of aid to Nepal, with relief supplies delivered to Kathmandu and tunnel rescue experts arriving in the disaster zone.

title_en: Over 35,000 New Foreign-Invested Enterprises Established Nationwide in First Half of Year
summary_en: Data released by the State Administration for Market Regulation show that 35,000 new foreign-invested enterprises were established nationwide in the first half of the year, up 7.0% year-on-year, with 11,000 of them from Belt and Road partner countries, Arab states, and African Union countries combined, growing 19.3%, 20.6%, and 42.8% respectively. The consumer market became a new draw for foreign investment, as new foreign-invested enterprises in health and social work, wholesale and retail, and accommodation and catering grew 27.1%, 11.9%, and 11.7% respectively.

title_en: China Unveils New Measures to Accelerate Data Industry Development
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that the National Data Administration will launch a series of measures to speed up the data industry, including pilot data-annotation programs in 32 cities, new token-based business models, and the opening of over 6 billion high-value data records by 14 central state-owned enterprises. The China Data Industry Development Report (2026), released at the 2026 China International Big Data Industry Expo, shows the industry has surpassed 6 trillion yuan in scale, with AI-related data products and services accounting for over 70 percent of total output and more than 480,000 data enterprises nationwide.

title_en: Inner Mongolia Accelerates Green Industry Development
summary_en: Inner Mongolia is developing new energy industries and promoting green, low-carbon transformation of traditional industries during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including direct green power supply to computing centers in Horinger New Area and solar-plus-ecological restoration projects in Ordos' coal mining subsidence areas. The region plans to add over 30 million kilowatts of new energy capacity annually and reach 325 million kilowatts of total installed new energy capacity by 2030.

title_en: Multilingual Edition of 'Classics Quoted by Xi Jinping' Airs on Mainstream Media in SCO Countries
summary_en: On August 30, on the occasion of President Xi Jinping's attendance at the 2026 SCO Summit and state visit to Kyrgyzstan, a launch event for the multilingual edition of 'Classics Quoted by Xi Jinping' was held in Bishkek, with a congratulatory letter from Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov. The program, which presents classical Chinese quotations cited in Xi's speeches and writings, is airing on mainstream media across SCO countries including Kyrgyzstan, Belarus, India, Kazakhstan, Pakistan, Russia, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and Iran.

title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Bishkek to Attend 2026 SCO Summit and Pay State Visit to Kyrgyzstan
summary_en: President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek on August 30 for the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit and a state visit to Kyrgyzstan at the invitation of Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, who welcomed Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan at Manas International Airport with traditional ceremonies. In a written statement, Xi praised 34 years of China-Kyrgyzstan relations and the two countries' comprehensive strategic partnership, citing the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway and record bilateral trade, and said he would hold in-depth talks with Japarov and looked forward to the SCO Bishkek summit.

title_en: Xi Jinping Leaves Beijing to Attend 2026 SCO Summit and Pay State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
summary_en: On the morning of August 30, President Xi Jinping departed Beijing by special plane for Bishkek to attend the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit and, at the invitations of Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, to conduct state visits to both countries. Accompanying Xi were his wife Peng Liyuan, Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, and Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Iran's Revolutionary Guard declared the Strait of Hormuz closed to ships passing without Iranian coordination while the U.S. maintains a naval blockade, that Japan's record ¥15.4 trillion currency intervention failed to stop the yen's slide to 160.2 per dollar, and that Spain's Interior Minister Fernando Grande-Marlaska announced extraordinary measures to tighten border control at the Ceuta enclave, where about 5,000 irregular migrants remain.

title_en: CCTV's Premium Film and Television Programs Launch Broadcast Events in Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
summary_en: China Media Group launched broadcast events for its premium film and television programs in Bishkek and Cairo, timed to President Xi Jinping's attendance at the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt. Programs including "Letters from President Xi" and "Xi Jinping's Cultural Sentiments" will air on mainstream media in both countries, with coverage by SCO member state and Egyptian outlets.

title_en: Kyrgyzstan Voices: President Xi Jinping's Signed Article Charts Direction for Opening a New Phase of High-Quality Development in Bilateral Relations
summary_en: Ahead of his state visit to Kyrgyzstan and the 2026 SCO summit in Bishkek, President Xi Jinping published a signed article in Kyrgyz media titled "Working Together to Open a New Phase of High-Quality Development in China-Kyrgyzstan Relations." Kyrgyz figures and international observers said the article charts the direction for high-quality development of bilateral ties and injects new momentum into building an SCO community with a shared future, with expectations that the Bishkek summit will lift that effort to a new level.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the Ministry of Finance and other departments urgently allocated 150 million yuan for flood and typhoon disaster relief in Zhejiang, Fujian and Guangxi, and that the National Development and Reform Commission arranged 100 million yuan for post-typhoon recovery in Zhejiang and Fujian; it also covers the expansion of the RMB cross-border payment system, China's trade with other SCO member states reaching 523.5 billion dollars in 2025 and with Kyrgyzstan 11.7 billion dollars in the first seven months of this year, China's first two-way high-speed laser communication between Earth and the Moon, the start of joint testing on the Hengshui-Huanghua Port high-speed railway, the 2026 Lu Xun Literary Prize ceremony in Shanghai, and the close of the 2026 Global Entrepreneurs Summit in Beijing.

title_en: Major Health Indicators for Chinese Residents Continue to Improve
summary_en: China's National Health Commission released its 2025 statistical bulletin on health development, reporting that average life expectancy reached 79.25 years by the end of 2025 and that major health indicators continued to improve. Average outpatient and inpatient costs per visit fell year-on-year, with community health center outpatient costs down 11.7% to 150.1 yuan and township health center outpatient costs down 9.4% to 79.4 yuan, while the country had 1.108 million medical institutions, 13.455 million health technicians, and 10.65 billion total patient visits for the year.

title_en: China's Logistics Sector Steady with Progress in First Seven Months
summary_en: Citing China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing data, the segment reports that China's total social logistics value reached 214.5 trillion yuan in January-July, up 5.0% year-on-year, with manufacturing logistics—especially equipment manufacturing (up 12.3%) and high-tech manufacturing (up 16.9%)—driving growth, while consumer-goods logistics rose 3.7% and imports of computer, communications, electronics and intelligent/automated equipment grew.

title_en: 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services to open in Beijing on September 9
summary_en: At an August 28 State Council Information Office press conference, officials from the Ministry of Commerce and Beijing said the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services will open on September 9 at Shougang Park in Beijing, with about 90 countries and international organizations exhibiting and holding events and more than 1,800 companies participating on-site. This year's fair will highlight new technologies, solutions and achievements in services trade fields such as information and communications, fintech, digital and intelligent healthcare, smart education, and energy conservation and environmental protection, and will for the first time set up a "China Services" exhibition area in the core zone of the thematic exhibition along with a dedicated "Going Global Services" area, and will release authoritative reports including the China Services Trade Development Report.

title_en: Digital Industry Revenue Exceeds 20 Trillion Yuan in First Half of Year
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's digital industry generated 20.71 trillion yuan in revenue in the first half of the year, up 13.6% year-on-year, with total profits of 1.79 trillion yuan, up 19.3%, driven by domestic AI demand and strong exports. The segment also notes that 5G base stations reached 5.102 million by the end of June and that 16 national-level advanced manufacturing clusters have been built in fields such as integrated circuits and artificial intelligence.

title_en: China to Roll Out Multiple Measures to Boost Effective Investment
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that the National Development and Reform Commission said China will take multiple measures to spur effective investment, noting that high-tech industry investment rose 5.0% year-on-year in January-July and integrated circuit manufacturing investment rose 11.5%. Next steps include advancing "Two Major" construction and central budget investment projects, accelerating local government special bond issuance, deploying new policy-based financial instruments, and launching major projects open to private enterprises.

title_en: All forces push into core disaster area as mudslide rescue continues in Gyirong County, Tibet
summary_en: A mudslide in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, has caused heavy casualties and left people missing; rescue teams are conducting grid searches, air-dropping supplies with drones and helicopters, clearing the destroyed National Highway 216, and monitoring a barrier lake formed upstream, while medical teams visit resettlement sites and, at Nepal's request, the Ministry of Emergency Management dispatched tunnel rescue experts to Nepal for hydropower station tunnel rescue work.

title_en: Central Party School (National Academy of Governance) holds autumn semester opening ceremony; Cai Qi attends and delivers speech
summary_en: The Central Party School (National Academy of Governance) held its 2026 autumn semester opening ceremony on the 29th, where Politburo Standing Committee member and school president Cai Qi delivered a speech urging comprehensive study of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and Xi Jinping's thought on Party building, and calling on cadres to uphold the "two确立" and "two维护." Shi Taifeng also attended the ceremony.

title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey: Implementing the Global Governance Initiative to Build a Better World
summary_en: The segment reviews the Global Governance Initiative Xi Jinping proposed a year ago at the SCO Tianjin summit, saying it has drawn support from nearly 160 countries and international organizations, and details China's actions on multilateralism, development, and emerging-domain governance ahead of the SCO summit in Bishkek.

title_en: News Roundup
summary_en: The segment covers the opening of the 2026 China International Big Data Industry Expo in Guiyang, the third APEC Senior Officials' Meeting of 2026 in Dalian, US President Donald Trump's executive order renaming Lake Ontario, and Iranian warnings of countermeasures against US economic pressure.

title_en: Shenzhou-23 Crew Completes Extravehicular Activity Successfully
summary_en: At 13:59 on August 28, after about 5.5 hours of extravehicular activity, Shenzhou-23 astronauts Zhu Yangzhu, Zhang Zhiyuan and Li Jiaying, working with the space station's robotic arm and ground researchers, completed tasks including extravehicular repair of the solar wings and installation of space debris shielding; astronauts Zhu Yangzhu and Zhang Zhiyuan returned safely to the Tianhe core module. This was China's second extravehicular repair of the solar wings, and the three astronauts have now been working in orbit for more than three months.

title_en: All parties carry out rescue and relief in Gyirong County, Tibet mudslide disaster
summary_en: A mudslide in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, has caused casualties and left people missing, prompting coordinated rescue efforts including a fire and rescue team that reached the worst-hit Gyirong port area after an 8-hour trek, road clearing by the armed police and Tibet transport department, and air, water and land search teams for missing people. About 500 threatened residents near Gyirong port have been placed in four temporary shelters, 555 tourists in Gyirong town have been evacuated, and supplies and medical teams have been dispatched.

title_en: 24th Session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee Closes in Beijing
summary_en: The 14th NPC Standing Committee concluded its 24th session in Beijing on the 28th, chaired by Chairman Zhao Leji, passing laws on medical security, farmland protection and quality improvement, revised agriculture and national defense mobilization laws, and amendments to the lawyers law, along with personnel appointments and removals including a new minister of civil affairs and changes to the Central Military Commission and National Supervisory Commission. Zhao Leji delivered remarks on legislation under the 15th Five-Year Plan, and a constitutional oath ceremony and a special lecture were held.

title_en: Li Qiang Directs Rescue and Emergency Response Work in Gyirong, Tibet
summary_en: Entrusted by Xi Jinping, Premier Li Qiang visited Gyirong County in Shigatse, Tibet on August 27 to direct rescue and emergency response after a mudslide disaster at the Gyirong port, conveying Xi's concern for affected residents and calling for all-out search and rescue of missing persons, restoration of infrastructure, and proper resettlement and relief work.

title_en: Xi Jinping Publishes Signed Article in Kyrgyz Media
summary_en: On the eve of his state visit to Kyrgyzstan and the 2026 SCO summit in Bishkek, President Xi Jinping published a signed article titled "Working Together to Open New Prospects for High-Quality Development of China-Kyrgyzstan Relations" in the Kyrgyz newspaper Slovo Kyrgyzstana and the Kabar national news agency, reviewing bilateral ties and outlining cooperation priorities ahead of his meeting with President Sadyr Japarov.

title_en: Xi Jinping Signs Presidential Orders
summary_en: President Xi Jinping signed Presidential Orders No. 80 through No. 85 on August 28, promulgating laws passed or amended by the 14th NPC Standing Committee's 24th session, including the Medical Security Law, the Farmland Protection and Quality Improvement Law, the Agriculture Law, the National Defense Mobilization Law, and amendments to the Lawyers Law. Order No. 85 removed Lu Zhiyuan as Minister of Civil Affairs and appointed Li Changguan to the post.

title_en: Comrade Chen Wu's remains cremated in Beijing
summary_en: The remains of Chen Wu, a senior Party member and Vice Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, were cremated at Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery in Beijing on August 28; he died of illness in Beijing on August 24, 2026, at age 72. Xi Jinping, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi, Han Zheng and others attended the farewell, and Xi Jinping, Li Qiang, Hu Jintao and other leaders expressed condolences to his family.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Message of Condolence to Nepal's President Over Landslide Disaster; Li Qiang Sends Message of Condolence to Nepal's Prime Minister
summary_en: On August 28, President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence to Nepali President Ram Chandra Paudel over a severe landslide at the Gyirong-Rasuwagadhi border crossing between China and Nepal that caused casualties, missing persons and property losses, pledging Chinese search-and-rescue efforts and assistance to Nepal. The same day, Premier Li Qiang sent a message of condolence to Nepali Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli.

title_en: Politburo of the CPC Central Committee Holds Meeting to Study and Deploy Rescue and Relief Work for the Jilong County Mudslide Disaster in Xigaze City, Tibet; Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Presides Over the Meeting
summary_en: The Politburo met on August 28, presided over by Xi Jinping, to study and deploy rescue and relief work after a mudslide originating on the Nepalese side caused heavy casualties and missing persons at the Jilong Port in Jilong County, Xigaze City, Tibet. The meeting opened with a moment of silence for the victims, and it called for scientific search-and-rescue efforts for missing persons at home and abroad, monitoring of barrier lakes and mountain stability to prevent secondary disasters, resettlement and relief for affected residents, and emergency assistance and international rescue cooperation for disaster-hit areas in Nepal.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Russian State Duma Chairman Vyacheslav Volodin urged Japan's leadership to face its history of aggression after their remarks on President Putin's visit to Iturup Island, while Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe announced a 50% retaliatory tariff on U.S. liquor imports starting September 8 and U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said there are no open communication channels with Canada after trade talks broke down; the WHO also reported over 5,600 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC.

title_en: Iran Says Military Doctrine Shifts from Defense to Offense; US Says No Timetable for Resuming Talks
summary_en: Iranian army spokesman Akraminia said Iran's military doctrine has shifted from defense to offense and that its armed forces are prepared to launch preemptive strikes against enemies if necessary, while IRGC spokesman Mohbi said the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen unless the US accepts Iran's conditions including lifting the blockade and sanctions; Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi wrote to the UN condemning US economic pressure as "economic terrorism." US President Donald Trump said he has set no timetable for resuming US-Iran talks, claiming the US has achieved a very big victory and that Iran's economy is collapsing.

title_en: Nepal mudslide disaster kills 289, hundreds missing
summary_en: Nepal's Rasuwa district in the north has been hit by a mudslide that has killed at least 289 people and left 910 missing, including hundreds of foreign tourists, according to Nepali police and other sources cited on August 27. Nepal's National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority said the disaster damaged 35 vehicular bridges, 45 suspension bridges and 40 kilometers of paved road, and the government has launched an emergency response to reopen blocked roads and restore water, power and communications.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on a one-year special campaign on road motor vehicle production consistency and quality improvement launched by MIIT and other departments, a joint document on developing intellectual property data resources, the launch of a national medical insurance pathology cloud, the 27th rotation of the PLA Macao Garrison, completion of pre-navigation trial runs for the Pinglu Canal, and the departure of China's first scheduled China-Laos-Thailand express freight train from Zhengzhou.

title_en: China Accelerates Construction of One-Hour Commuting Circles in Metropolitan Areas
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that China is accelerating one-hour intercity commuting networks, citing a new direct cross-provincial bus from Tianjin to Beijing and the start of no-passenger trial runs on Line 22 (Hongmiao–Pinggu), the first urban rail line spanning Beijing and Hebei. The plan aims to cover 75% of the population in major metropolitan areas with one-hour commuting access by 2030.

title_en: China's Energy-Intensive Industries Accelerate Energy Saving and Carbon Reduction
summary_en: CCTV reports that high-energy-consuming sectors such as steel, glass and cement are advancing green transition through technological innovation, waste heat recovery and resource recycling, with key steel enterprises cutting energy consumption and the three-year extreme energy efficiency program having reduced CO2 emissions by 60 million tons. The country has launched a three-year energy saving and carbon reduction campaign covering nine major energy-intensive industries, aiming to phase out inefficient capacity and drive upgrades toward efficient, clean, low-carbon and circular production.

title_en: Frontline Research: The New Efficiency of 'Revitalizing' Idle Assets
summary_en: The segment reports on a national platform launched by the Ministry of Finance last year that matches idle state-owned assets held by government agencies and public institutions with units that need them, citing examples such as construction machinery from a Qinghai vocational university being transferred to road maintenance and research equipment moving between universities. By the end of June 2026, the platform had gathered over 710,000 supply and demand listings and completed transfers of 90,000 units of assets, saving roughly 1.6 billion yuan in budget funds based on original asset value.

title_en: China's Robotics Industry Sees Continuous Innovation
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's robotics industry posted 165.5 billion yuan in revenue from above-scale enterprises in the first half of 2026, up 24.5% year-on-year, with embodied AI robots being tested in nearly 300 scenarios in Beijing and rapid prototyping in Shenzhen; China holds about two-thirds of global robot patent applications, its domestic-brand industrial robots exceed 50% market share, and it became a net exporter of industrial robots in 2025.

title_en: New Interest Subsidy Policy Takes Effect for Loans to Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises and Service Sector Business Entities
summary_en: China's six major state-owned commercial banks announced that a new central government interest subsidy policy has taken effect, providing an annualized 1 percentage point subsidy for up to two years on eligible working capital loans to small and medium-sized private enterprises issued since August 1, the first time such fiscal subsidies have been extended to this category of loans. The policy also raises the per-borrower loan ceiling eligible for subsidies at a single bank from 50 million to 75 million yuan for SME loans and from 10 million to 20 million yuan for service sector business entity loans, with banks handling the reporting of already-issued qualifying loans without requiring action from the enterprises.

title_en: China's New Momentum Index for Economic Development Maintains Rapid Growth
summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics released the 2025 New Momentum Index for China's economic development on August 27, showing the index at 153.0, up 12.5% year on year. The transformation and upgrading sub-index rose 22.7% to 156.8 and the innovation-driven sub-index rose 12.9% to 156.3, reflecting continued growth of strategic emerging industries and strengthening of China's strategic scientific and technological capabilities.

title_en: Profits of China's Industrial Enterprises Above Designated Size Maintain Relatively Fast Growth in First Seven Months
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): Data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on August 27 shows that from January to July, industrial enterprises above designated size achieved total profits of 4.58206 trillion yuan, up 17.6% year on year, maintaining relatively fast growth. Profits in high-tech manufacturing above designated size rose 50.1% year on year, contributing 9.6 percentage points to the profit growth of all industrial enterprises above designated size, while profits in electronics-related industries grew 1.1-fold, driven by the expansion of "AI Plus" applications and sustained growth in computing power demand.

title_en: Enhancing Citizens' Legal Literacy, Cultivating Rule-of-Law Belief Across Society
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on August 27 at which officials from the Ministry of Justice and other departments briefed on implementation of the "Ninth Five-Year" plan for rule-of-law publicity and education. Building on a review of the "Eighth Five-Year" period's results, the plan takes the Law on Rule-of-Law Publicity and Education as its binding legal basis, shifting such work from policy-driven to law-based implementation, with promoting Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law as the primary task and enhancing citizens' legal literacy and cultivating society-wide belief in the rule of law as core goals.

title_en: 14th NPC Standing Committee Holds 72nd Council of Chairpersons Meeting
summary_en: The 72nd meeting of the Council of Chairpersons of the 14th NPC Standing Committee was held in Beijing on the afternoon of the 27th, chaired by Chairman Zhao Leji. The meeting heard reports on revisions to draft laws including the medical security law, farmland protection and quality improvement law, agriculture law, national defense mobilization law, and amendments to the lawyers law, as well as a report on the extradition treaty between China and Hungary, and decided to submit the revised drafts to the Standing Committee session for deliberation.

title_en: All parties mobilize full efforts for mudslide rescue in Gyirong County, Tibet
summary_en: A mudslide originating on the Nepalese side struck the Gyirong Port area in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, causing casualties and missing persons, with 3 dead and 558 missing as of 8 a.m. on August 27; Xi Jinping issued important instructions, and national and regional authorities deployed firefighting, engineering, military, and aviation rescue teams, communications support, and emergency funding, while also monitoring a barrier lake upstream with a high risk of outburst.

title_en: Entrusted by General Secretary Xi Jinping, Li Qiang Arrives in Gyirong, Tibet to Guide Rescue and Disaster Relief Work
summary_en: Entrusted by General Secretary Xi Jinping, Li Qiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, led relevant responsible officials to the mudslide-affected area in Gyirong Town, Gyirong County, Tibet on the afternoon of August 27 to guide rescue and disaster relief work and to visit rescue personnel and affected residents in resettlement.

title_en: First and Second Volumes of 'Selected Cultural Writings of Xi Jinping' Published and Distributed
summary_en: Edited by the Institute of Party History and Literature of the CPC Central Committee, the first and second volumes of 'Selected Cultural Writings of Xi Jinping' have been published by the Central Party Literature Press and distributed nationwide. The volumes collect 78 of Xi Jinping's most important writings on cultural development from November 2012 to February 2026, including 27 in the first volume (November 2012–December 2016) and 51 in the second volume (October 2017–February 2026), some published publicly for the first time.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov confirmed Russian intelligence services had contact with CIA Director Ratcliffe, with President Vladimir Putin briefed on the results but not meeting Ratcliffe; that Israel, with National Security Minister Ben-Gvir leading, demolished a UNRWA vocational training center in East Jerusalem, drawing Palestinian and UN condemnation; that Spain advanced draft reforms to its immigration and asylum procedures to address the migrant crisis in Ceuta; and that wildfires in Texas have spread rapidly, prompting evacuations.

title_en: Canada Announces Equal Counter-Tariffs on US, Covering Over 700 Goods
summary_en: Canada's federal government announced it will impose 15%–50% counter-tariffs on more than 700 US goods worth 27.6 billion Canadian dollars, covering steel and aluminum, dairy, home appliances and agricultural equipment, effective September 8, alongside an aid plan for small and medium-sized Canadian firms hit by the trade war. The same day, US President Donald Trump said on social media that Canada has been "ripping off" the US and that he is considering renaming Lake Ontario "Lake America," to which Canadian Industry Minister Mélanie Joly responded that Canada will not change the lake's name and will defend all its interests.

title_en: Omani Foreign Minister Visits Iran; Iran Announces Temporary Shipping Route Arrangements for Strait of Hormuz
summary_en: According to a joint statement issued by Iran and Oman on the 25th, Omani Foreign Minister Badr visited Iran that day and discussed with Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi a phased framework for restoring navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, including establishing a mutually agreed temporary shipping corridor and joint minesweeping in the strait. Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi said the temporary corridor arrangement permits only commercial vessels to transit the strait and does not mean the Strait of Hormuz will immediately reopen; separately, U.S. media reported that Secretary of State Rubio told allied foreign ministers that the United States will temporarily avoid new military action against Iran and instead increase economic pressure through a continued maritime blockade and new sanctions.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period State Grid will expand cross-provincial power transmission capacity to 500 million kilowatts, that three departments issued a notice to improve contracted family doctor services, and that cross-border land-air combined transport between Hengqin and Macao officially opened on August 26 with the first batch of cross-border e-commerce goods shipped via Macao International Airport.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Meeting with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on August 26 under the theme 'Strivers on the New Journey,' featuring five exemplary public security representatives who discussed their work in criminal technology, traffic law enforcement, cybersecurity protection, public order, and smart policing, and shared stories of their efforts to safeguard national security, social stability, and public safety.

title_en: BeiDou system reaches about 90% penetration in key industries
summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology reports that BeiDou terminal equipment in key industries has reached nearly 40 million units, with comprehensive application penetration of about 90%. Over 98% of smartphones shipped in the domestic market in the first half of 2026 support BeiDou positioning, and some cities have achieved 100% BeiDou adoption in shared bikes, taxis, official vehicles, and agricultural machinery.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan: Integration and Upgrading Accelerate New-Type Industrialization
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on August 26, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology said China will launch a series of special initiatives during the 15th Five-Year Plan period to build a modern industrial system led by advanced manufacturing and to advance the building of a manufacturing powerhouse and a cyber powerhouse. The ministry also outlined plans to develop emerging pillar industries such as integrated circuits, aerospace and biomedicine, foster future industries including quantum technology, brain-computer interfaces and embodied intelligence, expand "AI+", "robot+" and "industrial internet+" application scenarios, and make 6G a top priority for the period.

title_en: Mudslide Disaster Causes Major Casualties and Missing Persons at Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet; All Parties Step Up Rescue Efforts
summary_en: A large-scale mudslide in the Rasuwa area of northern Nepal on August 26 caused major casualties and missing persons at Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet, burying buildings and cutting roads, with the Armed Police Shigatse Detachment dispatched to the scene. The Ministry of Emergency Management coordinated rescue forces including China Anneng Group experts and equipment, while central authorities allocated relief supplies and 120 million yuan in emergency disaster funds to support rescue and resettlement work.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Symposium on Pilot Fiscal Science Management in Hefei, Anhui
summary_en: Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang, a member of the Politburo Standing Committee, attended a symposium on pilot fiscal science management and conducted research in Hefei, Anhui, on August 25-26, calling for improved fiscal work to support Chinese-style modernization. During his visit he also inspected the Feixi County Finance Bureau and a science intelligence materials creation center at the University of Science and Technology of China.

title_en: 18th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee Concludes; Wang Huning Presides and Delivers Remarks
summary_en: The Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee concluded its 18th meeting in Beijing, with Wang Huning presiding and speaking on improving livelihoods and advancing common prosperity. The meeting approved personnel changes, including adding Fu Kui as a CPPCC National Committee member and removing Zhao Zongqi and Zhang Zhuohua from their posts and membership, and accepted Zhang Li's resignation.

title_en: 18th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee Holds Plenary Session, Delivering Speeches on "Increasing Efforts to Safeguard and Improve People's Livelihood, Solidly Advancing Common Prosperity for All"; Wang Huning Attends
summary_en: The plenary session of the 18th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee was held on the morning of the 26th, where 14 standing committee members delivered speeches on safeguarding and improving people's livelihood and advancing common prosperity for all. Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, attended.

title_en: Zhao Leji Meets with Uzbek Presidential Administration Head Mirziyoyeva
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji met in Beijing on the morning of August 26 with Mirziyoyeva, head of the Uzbek presidential administration, with both sides pledging to strengthen exchanges between their legislatures and deepen cooperation in economic, transport, education and counterterrorism fields.

title_en: Joint Group Meeting Held at 24th Session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee
summary_en: The 14th NPC Standing Committee held a joint group meeting in Beijing on the afternoon of the 26th to review the State Council's report on consolidating and expanding poverty alleviation achievements and advancing rural revitalization, and to conduct special inquiries. Chairman Zhao Leji attended, and Vice Premier Liu Guozhong and officials from relevant departments responded to questions.

title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Discussion with NPC Standing Committee Session Attendees
summary_en: Zhao Leji, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee and Chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee, met on the morning of the 26th with NPC deputies attending the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee, urging them to implement Xi Jinping's important expositions on 'three rural' work and central Party decisions, stay close to the people, and contribute to consolidating poverty alleviation gains and advancing comprehensive rural revitalization. Li Hongzhong presided over the discussion.

title_en: Li Qiang conducts research in Heilongjiang and Jilin
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang visited Heilongjiang and Jilin from August 24 to 26, inspecting farms, agricultural science parks, water conservancy projects, cooperatives, and a corn oil production line, and called for efforts to ensure an autumn grain harvest, boost comprehensive agricultural production capacity, and develop modern large-scale agriculture.

title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend 2026 SCO Summit and Pay State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
summary_en: China's Foreign Ministry announced on August 26 that President Xi Jinping will attend the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Bishkek from August 30 to September 3, and will pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan at the invitation of President Sadyr Japarov and to Egypt at the invitation of President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi.

title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Mudslide Disaster in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet, Emphasizing All-Out Search and Rescue of Missing Persons, Strengthening Investigation and Rectification of Various Risk Hazards, and Ensuring the Safety of People's Lives and Property; Li Qiang Issues Instructions
summary_en: A mudslide originating on the Nepalese side struck the Gyirong Port area in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet, on August 26, causing casualties and leaving people missing. Xi Jinping ordered all-out search and rescue of the missing, treatment of the injured, and prevention of secondary disasters, while Li Qiang issued instructions on rescue efforts and coordination with relevant countries, and Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing was dispatched to the scene to guide the response.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres urged all parties to cooperate on a confidence-building mechanism to address shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb; Yemen's Houthis claimed attacks on a Saudi oil tanker near Yanbu and on Saudi forces in Yemen; the EU's Copernicus climate service reported a record global daily average sea surface temperature of 21.10°C; and a tornado in southern France's Aude department injured 41 people and damaged about 300 homes.

title_en: UK Prime Minister says he has approved sharing missile manufacturing technology with Ukraine; Russia says it will destroy related targets
summary_en: British Prime Minister Burnham, visiting Ukraine, said he has approved sharing "Storm Shadow" cruise missile manufacturing technology with Ukraine so it can produce the missiles independently. Kremlin spokesman Peskov said the move is extremely negative and "adds fuel to the fire," and that Russian forces are gathering information to locate and destroy missile production sites in Ukraine.

title_en: US Threatens to Further Raise Tariffs on Canada; Canada Says It Will Not Accept Unequal Bilateral Relationship
summary_en: US President Trump said in a social media post on the 24th that the US will raise import tariffs to 50% on Canadian automobiles, auto parts, steel and other products starting January 1, 2027, accusing Canada of taking advantage of the US in trade for years. Canadian Prime Minister Carney responded the same day that Canada will return to the negotiating table only if the US changes its attitude and builds a genuine partnership, saying he does not accept the view that Canada is a subordinate of the US or that Canada holds an unequal position in its relationship with the US.

title_en: US Announces New Round of Sanctions on Iran; Iran Says US Will Fail Again
summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent announced on the 24th a new round of "economic isolation" sanctions expanding to five sectors—aviation, digital assets, gold, shipping, and technology—aimed at cutting off every economic lifeline of the Iranian government. Iranian Supreme Leader adviser Mokhber said Iran's response would be more resolute than ever, and Economy and Finance Minister Madanizadeh said Iran is fully prepared and the US will fail again.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that over 2,800 pocket parks broke ground nationwide in the first half of the year, China's EV charging infrastructure reached over 23.68 million units by end-July, and a personal medical insurance cloud will be built during the 15th Five-Year Plan period; it also covers the 10th National Disability Prevention Day, outcomes of the 11th APEC Food Security Ministerial Meeting, the 29th rotation of PLA Hong Kong Garrison units, the third batch of the Young Lawyers Western Training Program, Beijing ports surpassing 15 million inbound and outbound travelers this year, the opening of the Jinan Huanggang Road Yellow River Tunnel, and heavy rain warnings as Typhoon Zitan approaches.

title_en: First Batch of National Parks Achieve Dual Gains in Ecosystem Quality and Flagship Species Numbers
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that China's first five national parks have improved both ecosystem quality and flagship species populations, with Tibetan antelope exceeding 70,000, wild Siberian tigers rising from 27 to 72, and wild Amur leopards from 42 to 115, while new species were discovered in Wuyishan. The segment also details efforts in Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park, where 38 aerial rope corridors were built to reconnect fragmented gibbon habitats.

title_en: 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade to be held in Xiamen from September 8 to 11
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on August 25, at which the Ministry of Commerce announced that the 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade will take place in Xiamen, Fujian, from September 8 to 11, with preparations essentially complete. Delegations from 123 countries and regions have registered to attend, 60 countries and regions will set up exhibitions, Finland and Saudi Arabia will serve as guest countries of honor, and the fair will feature sessions on investing in China, Chinese investment abroad, and international investment, along with reports and displays by AI and green low-carbon companies.

title_en: China Accelerates Opening and Sharing of Public Data to Empower Industries
summary_en: The segment reports that China has stepped up efforts this year to open and share public data, launching pilot programs for six categories of data-security technologies and publishing demonstration scenarios covering meteorological services, transportation, and healthcare. It adds that a national integrated government data-sharing hub has supported over 550 billion data calls and exchanges across departments and regions.

title_en: Major Transport Indicators Maintain Growth in First Seven Months of the Year
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's transport sector operated steadily in the first seven months of the year, with cross-regional passenger trips reaching 39.79 billion (up 0.8% year-on-year) and commercial freight volume at 32.97 billion tons (up 2.8%). Port cargo throughput totaled 10.56 billion tons (up 1.3%, with foreign trade throughput up 3.6%), and fixed-asset investment in transport reached 1.8152 trillion yuan, with projects including the Three Gorges new waterway channel, the Xinjiang Duku Expressway, and the Dalian Jinzhou Bay International Airport integrated transport hub under accelerated construction.

title_en: Nationwide Summer Grain Purchasing Enters Peak Period; Cumulative Purchases Exceed 90 Million Tons
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's summer grain purchasing has entered its peak, with various grain operators having purchased over 90 million tons of wheat and the market running basically stable. The segment highlights 24-hour drying operations at a grain depot in Tai'an, Shandong, to address high moisture in newly harvested wheat, and notes that the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration is using the minimum purchase price system to support the market and ensure farmers can sell their grain.

title_en: Han Zheng Meets Indian National Security Advisor and Special Representative on China-India Boundary Question Doval
summary_en: Vice President Han Zheng met in Beijing on the 25th with Indian National Security Advisor and Special Representative on the China-India Boundary Question Ajit Doval, with Han citing the consensus reached by Xi Jinping and Narendra Modi at their Kazan and Tianjin meetings and calling for strategic trust and proper management of differences, while Doval said Modi highly values ties with China and that India is willing to deepen mutually beneficial cooperation and properly handle the boundary issue.

title_en: 18th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee Opens; Wang Huning Attends
summary_en: The 18th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) National Committee opened in Beijing on the morning of the 25th, focusing on strengthening efforts to ensure and improve people's livelihoods and steadily advancing common prosperity for all. CPPCC National Committee Chairman Wang Huning attended the opening session, where Vice Premier He Lifeng delivered a report and Vice Chairman Shi Taifeng presided; the meeting also heard a report on the CPPCC's work in the first half of 2026.

title_en: 24th Session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee Opens in Beijing, Chaired by Zhao Leji
summary_en: The 14th NPC Standing Committee held the first plenary meeting of its 24th session in Beijing on the morning of the 25th, chaired by Chairman Zhao Leji. The session heard reports on draft laws including medical security, farmland protection and quality improvement, agriculture, national defense mobilization, lawyers, enterprise bankruptcy, banking supervision, and water law, as well as State Council and National Supervisory Commission legislative proposals, a report on the China-Hungary extradition treaty, reports on economic and budget execution and government debt management, cultural products and rural revitalization, and a report on delegate qualifications.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Strive to Create Achievements That Withstand the Test of Practice, the People, and History
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The program broadcast a CCTV Quick Comment titled "Strive to Create Achievements That Withstand the Test of Practice, the People, and History."

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Delivering Achievements for the People Through Solid Work
summary_en: The segment reports on a nationwide Party education campaign to establish and practice a correct view of political achievements during the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, citing Xi Jinping's guidance and examples such as the expansion of a fishing port and cold storage facilities in Dongshan County, Fujian, and local efforts to resolve long-standing problems in Guizhou, Jiangsu, Jilin and Qinghai.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: An Angus Reid Institute poll found 76% of Canadians surveyed support the government withdrawing from Canada-U.S. trade talks, while the EU urged Israel to cancel tenders and halt construction of the E1 settlement in the West Bank, warning it undermines the two-state solution and reportedly preparing sanctions.

title_en: Iran Issues New Regulations on Passage Through Strait of Hormuz
summary_en: Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority announced new rules on Strait of Hormuz transit, stating that vessels violating Iran's navigation regulations will face fines, seizure, or confiscation, and that shipowners must check a list of "violating vessels" before chartering. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei said Iran has not received a formal invitation to join the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement, signed on August 7 by Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan, but has raised proposals for regional security in discussions with member states; Pakistani Army Chief of Staff Munir visited Iran with a delegation the same day.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period China will launch a special healthcare-security initiative to support grassroots health services, including lump-sum payments to qualified county-level medical communities and bringing over 98% of village clinics under medical insurance designated management; that the Cyberspace Administration of China has handled more than 7,200 non-compliant group livestream rooms since launching a July campaign against disorder in online entertainment group livestreaming; and that the 21st China Changchun Film Festival opened on the evening of August 23, with 16 films shortlisted for the Golden Deer Awards across 10 categories and nearly 500 screenings planned over six days.

title_en: Comrade Chen Wu passes away
summary_en: Chen Wu, an outstanding member of the Communist Party of China, a loyal communist fighter, an outstanding leader on China's ethnic affairs and economic development fronts, and Vice Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, died of illness in Beijing at 15:05 on August 24, 2026, at the age of 72.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Press Conference with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a 'Strivers on the New Journey' meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on August 24, at which five outstanding representatives from the emergency management system discussed 'taking practical action to prevent risks and safeguarding the people through emergency response.' They shared their work in smart flood control, hazard investigation, safety governance, emergency rescue, and technology-assisted rescue, highlighting the image and sense of responsibility of emergency responders in the new era.

title_en: Typhoons Bring Heavy Rain to Southeast Coast; Multiple Regions Respond
summary_en: Typhoons Shadel, Zitan, and Jianlawi brought sustained heavy rain to China's southeast coast, prompting the China Meteorological Administration to raise its emergency response to Level III; Typhoon Jianlawi made landfall near Zhangban Town in Quanzhou, Fujian, and authorities suspended ferry routes, halted trains on Hainan's round-island high-speed rail, and evacuated fishing boats, while the National Development and Reform Commission allocated 50 million yuan in central budget investment to support post-disaster recovery in Guangxi.

title_en: China Accelerates Development of Full-Chain Science and Technology Service System
summary_en: The segment reports that China is building an integrated service system covering R&D, pilot testing, incubation, and technology trading to bridge the gap between scientific research and industrial needs, including 32 national manufacturing innovation centers, a pilot-testing network of 21 national-level platforms plus over 1,800 reserve platforms, and 416 certified technology business incubators. It also notes efforts to build a unified national technology trading service platform, with Shandong's technology market using large-model technology for intelligent matching.

title_en: Han Zheng Meets Kuwaiti Foreign Minister
summary_en: Vice President Han Zheng met with Kuwaiti Foreign Minister Jarrah in Beijing on the 24th, with Han noting the 55th anniversary of China-Kuwait diplomatic relations and calling for deeper strategic partnership, while Jarrah affirmed Kuwait's adherence to the one-China principle and thanked China for its support.

title_en: Wang Huning Meets US Representatives of the Third China-US 1.5-Track Dialogue
summary_en: Wang Huning, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC, met in Beijing on the 24th with US representatives attending the third China-US 1.5-track dialogue. Wang said China is willing to work with the US to implement the important consensus reached by President Xi Jinping and President Donald Trump, and the US side said the two countries' leaders' good relationship is the most valuable part of bilateral ties.

title_en: Wang Huning Chairs CPPCC Chairman's Council Meeting
summary_en: Wang Huning, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), chaired the 54th Chairman's Council meeting of the 14th CPPCC National Committee in Beijing on the 24th, where he delivered a speech and the meeting conveyed and studied General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions. The meeting approved a report on the CPPCC's work in the first half of 2026 and a decision to revoke the CPPCC National Committee membership of Gu Xueming, Hao Rong, Xin Bao'an and Li Heyue, subject to confirmation by the 18th meeting of the 14th CPPCC National Committee Standing Committee.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with King Abdullah II of Jordan
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing on the 24th with King Abdullah II of Jordan, who is on a state visit to China. Li said China is willing to work with Jordan to advance high-quality Belt and Road cooperation and deepen cooperation in trade, green development, digital and cultural fields, while King Abdullah II said Jordan firmly adheres to the one-China policy and hopes to raise Arab-Chinese relations to a new level.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Alamgir on Assuming Office as President of Bangladesh
summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a message to Alamgir congratulating him on becoming President of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, noting the two countries' traditional friendship and 51 years of diplomatic ties and expressing willingness to work with President Alamgir to deepen Belt and Road cooperation and build a China-Bangladesh community with a shared future.

title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions, Stressing Consolidation and Expansion of Achievements in Education on Establishing and Practicing a Correct View of Political Performance, Striving to Create Achievements That Withstand the Test of Practice, the People, and History; Cai Qi Chairs Meeting of the Central Leading Group for Party Building Work and Delivers Remarks; Li Xi Attends and Delivers Remarks
summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions calling for sustained efforts to consolidate the achievements of the education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political performance, and the Central Leading Group for Party Building Work met on the 24th, chaired by Cai Qi with Li Xi attending, to review the campaign and plan a long-term mechanism for upholding a correct view of political performance.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with King Abdullah II of Jordan
summary_en: President Xi Jinping held talks in Beijing with King Abdullah II of Jordan, who was on a state visit to China, and the two leaders oversaw the signing of cooperation documents and issued a joint statement on deepening the China-Jordan strategic partnership. They also exchanged views on the Middle East situation, with Xi setting out four principles on the Palestinian issue and Abdullah II expressing appreciation for China's impartial stance.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Ceremony to Welcome King of Jordan on Visit to China
summary_en: President Xi Jinping held a welcome ceremony at the Great Hall of the People on the afternoon of the 24th for King Abdullah II bin Al-Hussein of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, who is on a state visit to China. The ceremony included a 21-gun salute, the playing of both national anthems, and a review of the PLA honor guard, with Wang Yi and other officials in attendance.

title_en: 24 Solar Terms: End of Heat
summary_en: The segment explains the traditional solar term End of Heat (Chushu), the second term of autumn, describing the seasonal shift as summer heat subsides, crops ripen toward harvest, and coastal fishermen begin the fishing season. It also reflects on the cultural meaning of the term, including the traditional concept of "sheji" (state and grain) and the modern "big food concept".

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports the launch of Tanzania's Julius Nyerere Hydropower Project, built with Chinese participation and inaugurated by President Samia Suluhu Hassan; Syria's condemnation of an Israeli drone strike near Damascus; a U.S. federal judge's ruling striking down the suspension of immigrant visas for applicants from 75 countries; and a magnitude-5.8 earthquake in Japan's Ibaraki Prefecture that injured at least 37 people.

title_en: Canada announces equal retaliatory tariffs on US to take effect September 8
