summary_en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on the 22nd that Canada's equal retaliatory tariffs will take effect on September 8 in response to the US imposing 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods, covering sectors including dairy, steel, home appliances, pulp and paper, and electronics. Carney said the US raised new demands at the last minute of negotiations that lacked economic rationale and were unfair to Canada, and several Canadian provincial premiers expressed support for the federal government's decision.

title_en: Iran says countries participating in US 'economic war' on Iran will be considered enemies
summary_en: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Rezaei warned neighboring countries and states worldwide against joining the US 'economic war' on Iran, saying they would be treated as enemies and that 'not a drop of oil' would flow from the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz; Parliament Speaker Qalibaf also accused the US of bullying on behalf of Israel. Separately, Iranian armed forces General Staff commander Bagherzadeh said three Iranian pilots detained by Qatar are in poor health and called for their return to Iran.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the Financial Regulatory Administration issued an action plan to strengthen governance of non-auto insurance lines, that China's trade with other APEC economies exceeded 18 trillion yuan in the first seven months of the year, that three typhoons are affecting southeastern coastal areas with heavy rain and disaster relief supplies were dispatched to Guangxi, that China's delegation to the 48th WorldSkills Competition has been formed ahead of the September event in Shanghai, and that the 25th "Chinese Bridge" global finals for university students were held in Xiamen.

title_en: China's 16th Arctic Ocean Expedition Completes All Ice Station Surveys
summary_en: China's 16th Arctic Ocean expedition has completed all of its ice station surveys, with the icebreakers Xuelong and Xuelong 2 conducting multidisciplinary integrated surveys at 19 ice stations, including observations of the atmospheric boundary layer, sea ice physics, and under-ice ecology and oceanography. The expedition established an unattended observation network in the Arctic Ocean, achieving a historic breakthrough in multi-point networked observations in the central Arctic region, and tested and operationally applied domestically produced advanced ocean observation equipment.

title_en: Second World Humanoid Robot Games Open in Beijing
summary_en: The Second World Humanoid Robot Games, co-hosted by the Beijing Municipal Government and China Media Group, opened in Beijing on the evening of August 22, with more than 2,000 humanoid robots competing over five days in 30 athletic events and 21 scenario-based contests. In the opening 100-meter preliminaries, a robot from Team Tianzhuo ran 9.39 seconds, faster than the human world record of 9.58 seconds, while other events showcased advances in robot perception, decision-making and cluster coordination.

title_en: Domestic agricultural machinery debuts "new outfits"
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that domestically produced agricultural machinery is being upgraded and deployed to match practical needs, citing new corn harvesters in Jilin, electric tea pickers in Jiangsu, and smart duck-rearing sheds in Hebei, with over 7 billion yuan in cumulative central fiscal spending to advance work on weak-link equipment.

title_en: China's Mine Ecological Protection and Restoration Moves Toward Green and New Development
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that China's 262 resource-based cities are continuing to advance the green transformation of mines, with 699 national-level green mines now built, accounting for 67.7% of the national total, and 88 national industrial heritage sites established in resource-based cities, 33% of the national total. The National Development and Reform Commission said it will integrate mine ecological restoration with the cultivation of replacement industries and urban renewal, improve ecological compensation and investment and financing mechanisms, and accelerate a virtuous cycle of "treatment—value-added—feedback."

title_en: Multiple Commercial Banks Publish Optimized Implementation Plans for Consumer Loan Interest Subsidy Policy
summary_en: Several Chinese commercial banks, including ICBC and Agricultural Bank of China, announced that starting August 1 the annual interest subsidy cap per borrower for personal consumer loans and credit card installment business at a single bank will rise from 3,000 yuan to 5,000 yuan, with credit card subsidy coverage expanded to auto, home renovation and other specialized installments. The banks said no separate application is needed, no service fees are charged, and the expanded subsidies aim to lower household consumer credit costs and support consumption alongside trade-in programs.

title_en: China's E-commerce Achieves Steady, Innovative Development from January to July
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports, citing the Ministry of Commerce, that China's e-commerce sector grew steadily and innovatively in the first seven months of the year, with national online retail sales of goods and services up 4.8% year-on-year and contributing over half of the growth in total retail sales of goods and services. Online travel and online lifestyle services sales on key monitored platforms rose 24.9% and 16.3% respectively, while online retail sales of agricultural products and rural goods grew 12.8% and 5%.

title_en: Focusing Efforts, Working Diligently to Achieve a Good Start for the 15th Five-Year Plan: Qinghai Improves Its Ecological Protection and Restoration System to Fortify the 'China Water Tower' Ecological Barrier
summary_en: The segment reports that Qinghai, source of the Yellow, Yangtze and Lancang rivers, is advancing integrated protection and restoration of mountains, rivers, forests, farmland, lakes, grasslands and deserts in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, including grassland restoration at high altitude, native grass seed breeding, expanded sky-ground integrated ecological monitoring, and training for more than 20,000 herder ecological stewards. It also notes Qinghai's release of the Sanjiangyuan 'China Water Tower' Ecological Protection Support System Plan (2026-2035) with 52 key tasks and 37 major projects, and targets such as restoring 300,000 mu of land and keeping water quality at provincial boundary sections of the three rivers at Grade II or better.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Making Good Use of Red Resources and Carrying Forward the Red Bloodline
summary_en: The segment reports on China's efforts to protect and utilize revolutionary heritage sites and artifacts, citing Xi Jinping's emphasis on red resources as the Party's most precious spiritual wealth, and highlights summer visits to the Long March National Cultural Park across 15 provinces, new preservation guidelines for immovable revolutionary relics, and red-tourism initiatives in Beijing, Chongqing, Jiangxi and elsewhere.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas and eight foreign ministers, including those of Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan, condemned Israel's advancement of the E1 settlement plan in the West Bank; that Russia's Defense Ministry said it struck Ukrainian railway repair and logistics facilities near Kyiv with precision weapons and long-range drones, while Ukraine reported missile and drone attacks and claimed strikes on a Russian refinery and military airfield; and that Germany's gas storage level fell to 49%, the lowest on record for the same period.

title_en: Canada announces suspension of Canada-US trade talks and implementation of reciprocal countermeasures
summary_en: Canadian Prime Minister Carney announced late on the night of the 21st that Canada is suspending trade negotiations with the United States and recalling its negotiating delegation, saying the US side's last-minute revised terms were "unfair and illogical." US Trade Representative Greer said that because Canada refused to reach an agreement, the US will impose a 50% tariff on about $20 billion of Canadian imports starting the 22nd, to which Canada said it will implement reciprocal counter-tariffs.

title_en: Iran Says It Will Continue Strengthening National Defense to Counter Threats; U.S. Says It Will Not Abandon Military Option Against Iran
summary_en: On Iran's Defense Industry Day, Iranian Armed Forces Chief of Staff Abdolrahim Mousavi, IRGC Commander Ahmad Vahidi, and acting Defense Minister Ebn al-Reza said Iran's defense industry has made major progress and that Iran will keep strengthening its defenses and respond forcefully to any enemy threats. U.S. President Donald Trump said the shift to "economic war" does not limit U.S. military options against Iran and claimed the U.S. fully controls Iran's borders, while Omani Foreign Minister Badr al-Busaidi and Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi discussed by phone restoring free navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's total electricity consumption rose 1.7% year-on-year in July to 1.04 trillion kWh, that imports from more than 150 trading partners grew in the first seven months of the year, and that the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission issued a 2026-2030 action plan for high-quality development of cyberspace and information technology enterprises. It also covers Shanghai Lingang's 15th Five-Year Plan targets, a nationwide rollout of a deceased persons' financial account inquiry service, typhoon Zitan and heavy rain warnings for southern China, the close of the third UN dialogue on AI and human development in Xi'an, overseas performance of Chinese films, and an exhibition on Guangzhou's urban history.

title_en: [Cultural China Tour] Preserving the "Millennium Gaze" of Foguang Temple
summary_en: The segment reports on Foguang Temple in Wutai County, Shanxi, home to China's highest-ranking surviving Tang dynasty wooden structure, and on efforts to protect its cultural landscape: the planned Fanshi-Wutai expressway was rerouted nearly 8 kilometers around the temple so it would not intrude on the millennium-old sightline from the East Hall, and a special protection regulation for the temple's cultural landscape, expanding the protected area to about 84 square kilometers, took effect on May 1, 2025.

title_en: China Achieves Independent Mass Production of High-End Steel in Multiple Fields
summary_en: CCTV reports that Chinese steel enterprises, drawing on national key laboratories, have achieved breakthroughs in core technologies and begun independent mass production of high-end specialty steels, including a 0.07mm "cicada-wing" steel and low-expansion steel for aerospace composite molds. The segment says China has built a self-reliant R&D and mass-production system for high-end steel covering deep-sea equipment, shipbuilding and aerospace, with seven new high-end steel types achieving breakthroughs this year and three steel firms named to the global "Lighthouse Factory" list.

title_en: High-tech industry attracts 32.7% more foreign investment year-on-year in January–July
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The Ministry of Commerce's latest data show that in January–July this year, actual utilized foreign capital nationwide totaled 438.33 billion yuan, with more than 37,000 new foreign-invested enterprises established, up 4.4% year-on-year. Actual foreign investment in high-tech industries reached 182.31 billion yuan, up 32.7% year-on-year, accounting for 41.6% of total actual foreign investment nationwide, 12.2 percentage points higher than the same period last year; actual investment from Saudi Arabia, France, and South Korea grew 343.7%, 36.1%, and 15.8% respectively.

title_en: Shandong Builds Commercial Space Industry Hub, Aiming for Strong Start to 15th Five-Year Plan
summary_en: Shandong is developing a commercial space industry cluster centered on the Yantai Oriental Spaceport, China's only commercial sea-launch base, with a provincial coordination task force and targeted support policies; the spaceport has attracted over 40 companies and 38.5 billion yuan in investment, and the recent Jielong-3 launch carrying the Dongfang Huiyan hyperspectral satellites marked its first full satellite-rocket-ship industrial closed loop. The province aims by 2027 to have annual capacity for 100 launch vehicles and 150 commercial satellites, with the commercial space industry scale reaching 50 billion yuan.

title_en: Communiqué of the Sixth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China
summary_en: The Sixth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection concluded in Beijing on August 22, 2026, with 116 commission members attending and CCDI Secretary Li Xi delivering a speech. The session reviewed discipline inspection work for the first half of 2026, set requirements for the next stage, and elected Zhao Shiyong as a deputy secretary of the CCDI and Zhang Zhong as a member of its Standing Committee and deputy secretary.

title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey: Expanding New Space for Belt and Road Cooperation, Paving a Road to Win-Win
summary_en: The segment reports on progress in high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, citing Xi Jinping's remarks on mutual benefit and noting that over 150 countries and more than 30 international organizations have joined the initiative, with China-Europe freight trains, new-energy product exports and digital and green cooperation expanding in the first seven months of the year.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that seven countries—the UK, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway and Canada—issued a joint statement condemning Israel's advancement of the E1 settlement project in the West Bank; that Yemen's Houthi forces claimed drone attacks on an airport and an Aramco oil facility in Saudi Arabia's Najran region; and that the European Commission said it wants all migrants who illegally entered the Spanish enclave of Ceuta to return to Morocco.

title_en: Wildfires persist in Spain and other countries amid high temperatures and drought
summary_en: Wildfires in western Spain have continued to spread amid hot, dry weather, forcing hundreds of people to evacuate as of the 20th; meanwhile, a wildfire broke out about 60 kilometers east of Belgrade, Serbia, prompting Serbia to request international assistance. Germany's central bank, the Deutsche Bundesbank, reported that the ongoing drought has lowered water levels on the Rhine and other waterways, potentially weighing on Germany's economic recovery in the third quarter.

title_en: Iran Condemns New US Sanctions as "Economic Terrorism"
summary_en: Iran's Foreign Ministry issued a statement strongly condemning new US economic and trade sanctions, calling them "economic terrorism" and a violation of international law, while the US said it would intensify economic pressure and the USS Washington carrier strike group arrived in the Middle East to replace the USS Lincoln.

title_en: Russian Foreign Ministry: Japan Should Fully Acknowledge the Results of World War II and Stop Distorting Its History of Aggression
summary_en: Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Zakharova stated on the 20th that Japan should acknowledge and reflect on its history of aggression during World War II and stop "whitewashing" its wartime crimes.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the Export-Import Bank of China issued nearly 500 billion yuan in new manufacturing loans in the first seven months of the year, the Ministry of Finance issued 6 billion yuan in RMB treasury bonds in Macao, and regulators reported progress on personal information protection, quality-strengthening industrial chain projects, APEC agricultural and food customs agreements, data cooperation pilots, and the delivery of a domestically developed 115,000-tonne product tanker; it also previews an interview with UN Deputy Secretary-General Yasmin Fouad.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Press Conference with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a 'Strivers on the New Journey' meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on August 21, at which five representatives from the natural resources field discussed 'protecting natural resources and building a beautiful China.' They shared stories of their work in surveying and mapping technology, geological disaster prevention, deep-sea submersibles, farmland protection, and desertification control.

title_en: Sports Events Spark New Vitality in Economic Development
summary_en: The segment reports that sporting events, from city leagues to rural tournaments, are driving consumption and tourism, citing the 2026 "Village Super League" finals in Rongjiang, Guizhou, which drew over 5 million visitors and 5.255 billion yuan in tourism spending in half a year, and Jiangsu's "Su Super" league, which attracted over 1.85 million spectators and 9.59 billion yuan in monitored retail sales.

title_en: Vital China Research Tour: AI Speeds Up Scientific Innovation
summary_en: The segment reports that Anhui province has launched China's first innovation platform using AI to discover new materials and substances, built on a large model developed by the University of Science and Technology of China; a doctoral student used it to develop a fire-resistant material in under four months that extended firefighter suit protection from about ten seconds to half an hour. The platform, open to scientists worldwide, completes over a thousand experiments daily, and Anhui is coordinating with USTC Silicon Valley, Hefei Science Island and other units to accelerate commercialization of lab results.

title_en: China's Early Rice Output Stable Above 56 Billion Jin for Sixth Consecutive Year
summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics reported on August 21 that China's 2026 early rice output reached 56.58 billion jin, remaining above 56 billion jin for the sixth straight year, with per-mu yield of 397.6 kilograms. Output rose in Anhui, Fujian and Hubei, while the four main producing regions of Guangxi, Hunan, Guangdong and Jiangxi saw declines due to extreme weather such as typhoons; sown area totaled 71.164 million mu, up 22,000 mu year on year.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: Proactive Fiscal Policy Supports High-Quality Economic and Social Development
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on August 21, the Ministry of Finance said China is implementing a more proactive fiscal policy this year, with budgeted fiscal spending exceeding 30 trillion yuan for the first time, new government bonds totaling 11.89 trillion yuan, and central-to-local transfer payments reaching 10.42 trillion yuan, while 12.4 trillion yuan is allocated for education, social security, health care and housing and about 100 billion yuan in subsidies for childcare.

title_en: Zhao Leji Meets with King Abdullah II of Jordan
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji met with Jordan's King Abdullah II in Beijing on the morning of August 21, with both sides pledging to deepen cooperation and exchanges between their legislatures. Earlier that morning, King Abdullah II laid a wreath at the Monument to the People's Heroes in Tiananmen Square.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs State Council executive meeting
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on August 21 that heard a report on building next-generation communications networks, deployed further efforts to clear overdue payments owed to enterprises, and studied continued work to improve air quality. The meeting also reviewed and approved revised regulations on emergency response and investigation of electric power safety accidents and draft regulations on market supervision offices.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Undaunted by Wind and Waves, China's High-Quality Economic Development Moves Steadily and Far
summary_en: The segment reports that in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, China's GDP grew 4.7% year-on-year in the first half, with the IMF raising its forecast for China's growth by 0.2 percentage points, and highlights Xi Jinping's principle of coordinating development and security, citing energy and grain security measures, technological breakthroughs, and the Fourth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee's designation of coordinating development and security as a guiding principle.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on a Russian Pacific Fleet exercise near the disputed South Kuril Islands, a new arrest in Germany over the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline explosions, Iranian Parliament Speaker Qalibaf's visit to Baghdad for talks with Iraqi leaders, Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's warning to Turkey over its military presence in Syria and Turkey's response, and NASA's cancellation of a mission to boost the orbit of the Swift observatory.

title_en: US Federal Government Debt Exceeds $40 Trillion for First Time; US Media Say Structural Crisis in the US Is Worsening
summary_en: US Treasury data released on the 19th showed total US federal government debt reached about $40.05 trillion, surpassing $40 trillion for the first time; US media reported that the debt has more than doubled in under a decade, and analysts said the endless expansion of US debt is undermining global investors' confidence in its long-term credit built on dollar hegemony.

title_en: US President Says Devastating Economic Action Taken Against Iran; Iran Says Hostile Ships Barred from Strait of Hormuz
summary_en: US President Trump said in a post on the 19th that the United States is carrying out the most devastating economic action in history against Iran, describing it as an unprecedented economic war and isolation campaign that requires all allies to take part. Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi said on August 20 that the US economic action is meant to distract from domestic crises including unprecedented debt and rising interest costs, while Iran's parliamentary national security committee said hostile ships or those threatening Iran's national security are barred from the Strait of Hormuz, and Axios reported that the US military has quietly established a shipping corridor to ensure millions of barrels of oil leave the strait daily.

title_en: Japanese citizens protest Takaichi administration's dangerous moves, saying they are pushing the country to the brink of war
summary_en: On the evening of the 19th, a number of Japanese citizens held a protest rally in front of the National Diet building in Tokyo, criticizing the Takaichi administration's series of dangerous moves as pushing the country toward the brink of war and expressing strong opposition.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment covers a roundup of domestic news: the All-China Federation of Trade Unions released its 15th Five-Year Plan for building the industrial workforce, the National Healthcare Security Administration set basic medical insurance coverage at around 95 percent, China launched an "AI plus transportation" pilot program, the Supreme People's Court revised judicial interpretations on copyright cases, two ministries deployed service-based social assistance, the 240-hour visa-free transit policy expanded to 57 countries, the seventh China-Africa Media Cooperation Forum opened in Beijing, and over 100 white-lipped deer were recorded crossing the Yalong River in Sichuan's Shiqu County.

title_en: Harvest Season: Specialty Agricultural Products Help Farmers Increase Income
summary_en: The segment reports on autumn harvests of specialty agricultural products across China boosting farmer incomes, including red-fleshed kiwifruit in Liupanshui, Guizhou, where drones are now used to transport fruit; grapes in Fu'an, Fujian, handled through temperature-controlled sorting and cold-chain logistics; and seafood landings at fishing ports in Beihai, Guangxi, and Zhapo, Guangdong, following the opening of the South China Sea fishing season.

title_en: New growth drivers' contribution to China's industrial economy continues to strengthen
summary_en: CCTV reports that new growth drivers such as high-tech manufacturing and digital product manufacturing contributed about half of the growth in value-added of industrial enterprises above designated size from January to July, roughly 3 percentage points more than in the first half of the year, with rapid output growth in AI-related sensors, memory chips and optical fiber and faster growth in integrated circuit, aircraft and smart equipment manufacturing. In July, industrial exports maintained double-digit growth, with export delivery values in the automotive and electronics sectors rising 41.2% and 8.4% respectively and contributing 25.8% and 30.7% of the total increase.

title_en: Major Projects Across China Advance Steadily
summary_en: The segment reports steady progress on major infrastructure projects nationwide, including the completion of the main structure of the Huaifu hub on the Huai River seaward channel in Yancheng, Jiangsu, the start of trial operations on the Xi'an–Ankang high-speed railway in Shaanxi, and the launch of the second phase of a green methanol project in Taonan, Jilin.

title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Talks with President of El Salvador's Legislative Assembly
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji held talks in Beijing with Castro, President of El Salvador's Legislative Assembly, on the eve of the 8th anniversary of China-El Salvador diplomatic relations, with both sides pledging to deepen political trust, economic and cultural cooperation, and exchanges between their legislatures.

title_en: CPC Central Committee, State Council and Central Military Commission Decide to Award Zhang Lu the "Second-Class Aerospace Merit Medal" and Confer the "Heroic Astronaut" Honorary Title on Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang with the "Third-Class Aerospace Merit Medal"
summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, State Council and Central Military Commission issued a decision awarding Zhang Lu the Second-Class Aerospace Merit Medal and conferring the "Heroic Astronaut" title plus the Third-Class Aerospace Merit Medal on Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang for the Shenzhou-21 crewed mission, which set records for the fastest Shenzhou-space station rendezvous and docking and the longest single-crew in-orbit stay by Chinese astronauts.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Quality Medical Resources Sink to the Grassroots to Benefit the People, Painting a New Picture of a Healthy China
summary_en: The segment reports on the Communist Party's push under Xi Jinping to shift health work's focus to the grassroots, noting that over 80% of counties have built shared imaging, ECG and testing centers serving more than 330 million visits, and that grassroots medical staffing has grown nearly 50% from 2016 to 2025.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Hakainde Hichilema on His Re-election as Zambian President
summary_en: On August 20, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Hakainde Hichilema congratulating him on his re-election as President of the Republic of Zambia, noting their two meetings in recent years and expressing willingness to work with President Hichilema to implement the outcomes of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation Beijing Summit and further develop the China-Zambia comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Israeli airstrikes on an air base in Syria's Idlib province, which Syria's transitional government condemned as unjustified aggression, with Turkey and U.S. Syria envoy Barak criticizing the move; the DRC's confirmed Ebola cases surpassing 5,000 with 2,378 deaths as the WHO maintains the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern; and explosions at an industrial recycling facility in Ohio and at natural gasoline storage tanks in Oklahoma.

title_en: US President Says No Talks with Iran; Iran Says Strait of Hormuz to Remain Closed Until US Meets Conditions
summary_en: US President Donald Trump said on the 18th that the US naval blockade of Iran remains fully in effect and that Washington will not hold any talks or dialogue with Iran now or in the future, while Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf said the Strait of Hormuz will stay closed until the US meets the conditions of the memorandum of understanding, including lifting the blockade and sanctions and unfreezing Iranian assets. The segment also reports that the 60-day window for a final US-Iran agreement has passed without a breakthrough, and that the US 30-year Treasury yield reached 5.31% on the 17th, a new high since June 2007.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports a joint release by the Central Propaganda Department and National Health Commission of the "Most Beautiful Doctors" advanced deeds, honoring nine medical workers, and notes that China is advancing construction and modernization of 122 large and medium-sized irrigation districts with 15.8 billion yuan in central funds. It also covers the release of the world's first international standard for smart manufacturing in the steel industry led by China, the opening of the 2026 World Robot Conference in Beijing with over 3,000 exhibits, the 33rd Beijing International Radio, TV and Film Exhibition, a national children's choral performance in Shenyang, and CCTV's 2026 financial program slate and Qixi Festival gala.

title_en: 2026 Summer Movie Season Sets New Records for Screenings and Attendance; Film Industry Chain Output Value Exceeds 410 Billion Yuan
summary_en: The 2026 summer movie season has drawn over 290 million admissions across more than 34.5 million screenings, both record highs, with box office surpassing 10.6 billion yuan and the broader film industry chain output value exceeding 410 billion yuan this year, according to CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo.

title_en: China to Build Approximately 60,000 Kilometers of Premium Self-Drive Tourism Highways
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports, citing the Ministry of Transport, that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period China will accelerate development of a premium self-drive tourism highway system, built mainly on ordinary national highways and linking national cultural parks, core tourism resources, and distinctive landscapes, forming a roughly 60,000-kilometer main framework of "three rings, four horizontals, and five verticals." The three rings comprise the border-coastal loop, the capital metropolitan area loop, and the Qinghai-Gansu loop; the four horizontals cover Great Wall culture, Yellow River culture, Yangtze River culture, and the western snow-region sky road; the five verticals cover Grand Canal culture, East China world heritage sites, central China's scenic mountains, Long March culture, and ancient trail mysteries.

title_en: Localities Strengthen Field Management to Consolidate Foundation for Grain Harvest
summary_en: The segment reports that localities across China are seizing the farming season to carry out refined field management for autumn grain, the largest share of annual grain output, including smart irrigation in Heilongjiang, pest control in Hebei, new fertilization technology in Chongqing's Liangping, post-rainfall expert guidance in Henan, field care in Anhui's Xiaogang Village, and machinery deployment for recovery in Guangxi's Hengzhou.

title_en: Service Sector Expands Capacity and Quality, Helping Chinese Manufacturing Boost Global Competitiveness
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's service sector has continued to expand capacity and improve quality this year, with producer services moving toward higher-value segments and increasingly accompanying Chinese manufacturing overseas; in the first seven months, the production index for information transmission, software and IT services rose 10.6% year-on-year, and knowledge-intensive services such as software, IT and professional consulting accounted for more than half of service exports.

title_en: Chang'e-7 Spacecraft-Rocket Combination Completes Vertical Transfer
summary_en: The Chang'e-7 probe and its Long March 5 Y14 carrier rocket were transferred to the launch area at the Wenchang Space Launch Site in Hainan on August 19, with the transfer conducted in light-to-moderate rain and cloudy weather over more than two hours, demonstrating the rocket's ability to transfer and launch in moderate rain. The mission, which includes the Chang'e-7 probe (orbiter, lander, rover and a leaping vehicle) and the Queqiao-2 relay satellite, aims to survey the lunar south pole's environment and resources and is scheduled for launch in the coming days.

title_en: China Achieves First Land-Based Rocket Recovery
summary_en: On August 19, the Zhuque-3 Y2 carrier rocket lifted off from the Dongfeng Commercial Space Innovation Test Zone, placing the Honghu-03 satellite into its planned orbit, while its first stage completed China's first controlled land recovery using landing legs, marking another major breakthrough in reusable rocket technology. The Zhuque-3, a reusable liquid oxygen-methane rocket developed by LandSpace, is 66.1 meters long with a takeoff weight of 570 tons.

title_en: Establishing and Practicing a Correct View of Political Achievements: Promoting Learning Through Action, Ensuring Learning and Education Deliver Results
summary_en: Shenzhen and Shihezi (Eighth Division of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps) are deepening education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, combining study, inspection and rectification; Shenzhen has built a tiered AI course system for young people, holding 90 sessions and training over 6,100 people, while Shihezi has resolved more than 3,500 livelihood issues, including reorganizing a night market to reduce noise and fumes affecting nearby residents.

title_en: Zhao Leji Meets with Ecuadorian President Noboa
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji met with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa in Beijing on the morning of August 19, with Zhao noting that this year marks the 10th anniversary of the China-Ecuador comprehensive strategic partnership and calling for deeper practical cooperation and legislative exchanges. Noboa said Ecuador regards China as a good friend and partner and supports China's efforts to safeguard its sovereignty and territorial integrity.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Ecuadorian President
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing on the 19th with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa, who is on a state visit to China, with Li noting that this year marks the 10th anniversary of the establishment of the China-Ecuador comprehensive strategic partnership and expressing China's willingness to deepen cooperation in energy and minerals, trade, and livelihood areas. Noboa said China is an important partner and good friend of Ecuador and that Ecuador is ready to further unlock the benefits of the bilateral free trade agreement and expand mutually beneficial cooperation.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Building Higher-Standard Pilot Free Trade Zones to Create New Heights of Reform and Opening Up
summary_en: The segment reports on China's 23 pilot free trade zones, which cover less than 0.4 percent of the country's land area but account for more than a quarter of foreign investment and a fifth of total imports and exports, and highlights new institutional innovations such as expanded offshore trade financial reform in Shanghai's Lin-gang Special Area, a data export negative list in Beijing, zero-tariff coverage in Hainan, and bonded aircraft maintenance in Xiamen.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Sulyok on Assuming Office as President of Hungary
summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a message to Tamás Sulyok congratulating him on becoming Hungary's president, highlighting the two countries' traditional friendship and 77 years of diplomatic ties and expressing willingness to deepen political trust and practical cooperation to advance the China-Hungary all-weather comprehensive strategic partnership for the new era.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on U.S. envoy Jared Kushner's meetings with Hamas political bureau chief Yahya Sinwar and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with limited progress on a Gaza peace plan, Russia's warning to the UK over Ukraine's use of British drones to strike deep inside Russia, and a petition by over 220,000 Canadians seeking the expulsion of U.S. Ambassador to Canada Pete Hoekstra.

title_en: US Says It Will Not Extend Memorandum of Understanding; Iran Says It Will Not Accept Ultimatums
summary_en: US President Donald Trump said on the 17th that the United States does not plan to extend its memorandum of understanding with Iran and that the US is fully controlling the Strait of Hormuz through a blockade, warning that the US would attack Oman if it obstructed efforts to reopen the strait. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei said on the 17th that Iran would never adjust its policies under "pressure, ultimatums or time limits," and that because the US had seriously violated the memorandum of understanding, no dialogue was taking place between the two sides.

title_en: Russian Foreign Minister Criticizes Japan for Using Attacks on Russia to Conceal Aggressive Military Moves
summary_en: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said on the 17th that Japan is trying to use criticism of Russia to conceal its own aggressive military moves, commenting on Japan's protest over President Putin's visit to Iturup Island (called Etorofu by Japan). The Russian Foreign Ministry summoned Japanese Ambassador to Russia Akira Muto over Japan's response to Putin's visit, and the Japanese embassy later said Muto was unwell and unable to accept the summons.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Emergency Management allocated another 60 million yuan for flood relief in Henan, the central bank and foreign exchange regulator extended the multinational company cross-border cash pool policy nationwide, and instant settlement of medical insurance funds reached its annual target ahead of schedule; it also covers green building materials certification, Hengqin port passenger volumes, the Tianwan nuclear plant Unit 7 entering fuel-loaded testing, the Xinjiang Qitai radio telescope completing core structure installation, delivery of a 99,000-cubic-meter ethane/ethylene carrier, and forecasts of a potentially record-strong El Niño.

title_en: 2025 South China Sea Region Marine Ecological Conditions Generally Stable
summary_en: China's Ministry of Natural Resources South China Sea Bureau released two reports on the region's marine ecology, finding that overall conditions in 2025 were generally stable, with mangrove and seagrass ecosystems in good condition and mangrove coverage above 75 percent. The reports also provided the first overall assessment of the ecological conditions of the Xisha, Zhongsha and Nansha island reefs, highlighting the true ecological picture of nine of them, and noted that 66 marine ecological restoration projects were carried out in 2025 with total investment of nearly 5 billion yuan.

title_en: Macao SAR Government Officially Releases Third Five-Year Plan
summary_en: The Macao Special Administrative Region government officially released its Third Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development (2026-2030), setting 35 main economic and social development indicators and eight major development goals. Chief Executive Sam Hou Fai described the plan as a roadmap and task list for Macao's new stage of high-quality development and an important innovative measure for deepening the practice of "One Country, Two Systems" and integrating into and serving the country's overall development.

title_en: Yangtze River Delta Foreign Trade Hits Record High as 'New Growth Drivers' Lead High-Quality Development
summary_en: CCTV reports that customs data show goods trade imports and exports in the Yangtze River Delta reached a record high for the January-July period, totaling 11.41 trillion yuan, up 18.9% year-on-year and accounting for 37.9% of China's total foreign trade, with growth driven by high-tech products such as integrated circuits and high-end equipment, as well as exports to emerging markets including ASEAN, Latin America and Africa.

title_en: China to Accelerate Development of Modern Oil and Gas Industry System During 15th Five-Year Plan
summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and National Energy Administration jointly released the Petroleum and Natural Gas Development 15th Five-Year Plan, which calls for safeguarding energy security, advancing green transition, expanding oil and gas exploration and development, and pushing marine oil and gas output to the 100-million-ton scale. By 2030, domestic oil and gas supply is targeted at 440 million tons of oil equivalent, with 20,000 kilometers of new long-distance pipelines added to bring the national network to 220,000 kilometers and gradually establish an autonomous, controllable, green and low-carbon modern oil and gas industry system.

title_en: Multiple Measures to Further Energize Lower-Tier Markets
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on August 18 to present the Opinions on Further Energizing Lower-Tier Markets and Boosting County-Level Consumption, which focuses on county areas and offline consumption and sets out measures including accelerating the upgrading of existing commercial facilities, improving the supply of quality goods and services such as elderly and child care, raising the efficiency of urban-rural distribution networks, and supporting company headquarters and platform firms to locate in county areas to create jobs.

title_en: Zhao Leji Chairs 71st Council of Chairpersons Meeting of 14th NPC Standing Committee; Decides 24th Session of 14th NPC Standing Committee to Be Held in Beijing August 25-28
summary_en: Zhao Leji chaired the 71st Council of Chairpersons meeting of the 14th NPC Standing Committee at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, which decided that the 24th session of the Standing Committee will be held in Beijing from August 25 to 28. The proposed agenda includes deliberation of draft laws on medical security, farmland protection and quality improvement, and revisions to the agriculture law, national defense mobilization law, lawyers law, enterprise bankruptcy law, banking supervision law, and water law, as well as State Council bills, a National Supervisory Commission bill on combating cross-border corruption, and a treaty on extradition between China and Hungary, along with reports on economic and budget execution and other matters.

title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree Promulgating Decision to Amend Regulations on Housing Provident Fund Management
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree promulgating the Decision on Amending the Regulations on Housing Provident Fund Management, comprising 20 articles and taking effect September 20, 2026. The decision broadens the scope for withdrawing and using provident funds, including removing threshold limits on using funds for rent and adding renovation and property fee withdrawals, simplifies withdrawal procedures and enables nationwide mutual recognition of contribution records, strengthens risk control through credit records linked to the national credit information sharing platform, and extends coverage to self-employed individuals, part-time workers, and other flexibly employed persons who may contribute voluntarily.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Ecuadorian President
summary_en: President Xi Jinping held talks in Beijing with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa, who was on a state visit to China, marking the 10th anniversary of the two countries' comprehensive strategic partnership. The two leaders oversaw the signing of cooperation documents in areas including green industry, trade, the digital economy and livelihoods, and exchanged views on Latin America and the Caribbean.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Ceremony to Welcome Ecuadorian President on Visit to China
summary_en: President Xi Jinping held a welcome ceremony at the Great Hall of the People on the afternoon of the 18th for Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa, who is on a state visit to China at Xi's invitation. The ceremony included a 21-gun salute, the playing of both national anthems, and a review of the PLA honor guard, with Foreign Minister Wang Yi and other officials in attendance.

title_en: Comrade Zhu Rongji's body cremated in Beijing
summary_en: The body of Zhu Rongji, former Premier of the State Council and member of the 14th and 15th CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committees, was cremated at Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery in Beijing on the 18th after his death on August 12, 2026, at age 98. Xi Jinping, Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi and Han Zheng attended the farewell, while Hu Jintao sent a wreath to express condolences.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that US President Donald Trump said he asked the Pentagon to sharply scale back joint US-South Korea military exercises, that the foreign ministers of eight countries condemned Israel's rejection of a Gaza peace plan, and that Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reached a new high, alongside wildfires on a Greek island near Athens and flooding and power outages in Hawaii caused by Hurricane Lane.

title_en: Russia says it downed over 1,400 drones in a day; Ukraine strikes large Russian logistics hub
summary_en: Russia's Defense Ministry said on the 16th that Russian forces downed 1,478 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones over the past 24 hours, a single-day record according to Russian media, which also said Russian air defenses have downed more than 100,000 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones inside Russia this year. Ukraine's Defense Ministry said on the 16th that Ukrainian forces launched a large-scale drone attack on a logistics hub of the Russian e-commerce platform Wildberries in Moscow Region, saying 7 of the company's 10 large warehouses have halted operations due to the strikes.

title_en: Iran Says US and Israel Achieved No Goals in War on Iran
summary_en: Iranian officials, including Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf and President Masoud Pezeshkian, said the US and Israel failed to achieve any objectives in their war on Iran and that Iran did not yield, while Iran's army commander said US forces had been expelled from the Persian Gulf, Gulf of Oman and Strait of Hormuz; US media also reported growing frustration among Gulf allies, including Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar, over US policy toward Iran.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that new home prices in first-tier cities rose month-on-month in July, that eight government departments issued a notice to safeguard agricultural irrigation water, that China designated its first batch of 158 primary-care diseases paid at uniform rates, that Chang'e-6 lunar soil research offers new evidence on differences between the Moon's near and far sides, and that the TV drama "Cang Feng" premieres tonight on CCTV's main channel.

title_en: National Economy Generally Stable from January to July, Developing Toward Innovation and Improvement
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on August 17 where the National Bureau of Statistics spokesperson presented July economic data, reporting that from January to July the national economy maintained overall stability with development trending toward innovation and improvement, including 5.3% year-on-year growth in value-added of industrial enterprises above designated size, 4.7% growth in the national service sector production index, and 2.6% growth in total retail sales of consumer goods and services.

title_en: Seminar on Jiang Zemin's Life and Thought Held in Beijing; Cai Qi Attends Opening Ceremony and Delivers Speech
summary_en: A seminar on Jiang Zemin's life and thought was held in Beijing from the 17th to the 19th, with Politburo Standing Committee member and Central Secretariat Secretary Cai Qi attending the opening ceremony and delivering a speech. Cai called for deeper study of the "Three Represents" important thought in light of new era conditions, and Li Shulei presided over the meeting, with Shi Taifeng, Liu Guozhong, Zhang Shengmin, Qu Qingshan and Xin Changxing also speaking.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs the 12th Plenary Meeting of the State Council
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired the 12th Plenary Meeting of the State Council on August 17, calling for implementing General Secretary Xi Jinping's remarks on the current economic situation and economic work, and stressing efforts to meet this year's economic and social development targets and achieve a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan. Li cited generally stable economic performance with new growth drivers and improved structure, while noting insufficient domestic demand and difficulties in some industries, and urged full use of existing policies alongside timely new measures, expanded domestic demand, support for private investment, and coordination of development and security.

title_en: At Xi Jinping's invitation, King of Jordan to pay state visit to China
summary_en: At the invitation of President Xi Jinping, King Abdullah II of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan will pay a state visit to China from August 18 to 24.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Message of Condolence to Indonesian President Over Strong Earthquake in Indonesia
summary_en: On August 17, President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence to Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto over a strong earthquake in Indonesia, expressing condolences for the victims and sympathy to the bereaved families and the injured on behalf of the Chinese government and people, and expressing confidence that under the leadership of President Prabowo's government the Indonesian people will overcome the disaster and rebuild their homes.

title_en: Grand gathering held in Beijing to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth; Xi Jinping delivers important speech
summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, the NPC Standing Committee, the State Council, the CPPCC National Committee and the Central Military Commission held a grand gathering at the Great Hall of the People on the morning of the 17th to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the birth of Comrade Jiang Zemin, with Xi Jinping delivering an important speech. The event was attended by Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi, Vice President Han Zheng and some 6,000 representatives from various sectors.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Russia has formally demanded explanations from the US and Turkey over plans to approve Turkish transfer of US-made weapons to Ukraine, that the death toll from the strong earthquake near Indonesia's Flores Island has risen to 51, that Spain has reinforced deployments in Ceuta to prevent illegal crossings, and that wildfires have reignited in southern France and struck Belgium.

title_en: Iran says it has reached agreement with Oman on shipping route map for Strait of Hormuz
summary_en: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei said on the 15th that despite US obstruction, talks between Iran and Oman made positive progress and the two sides reached an agreement on a shipping route map for the Strait of Hormuz, with some issues still under discussion; the segment also reported that Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon killed at least 11 people, which Lebanese President Aoun strongly condemned.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China Development Bank issued over 10 billion yuan in elderly care industry loans in the first seven months of the year, Guangzhou Baiyun Airport handled over 6.5 million inbound travelers this year, China successfully launched the 24th batch of low-orbit satellite internet satellites via a Long March 12 rocket from Hainan, and 2026 summer box office revenue surpassed 10 billion yuan with the film industry chain's total output value exceeding 400 billion yuan.

title_en: Cultural China Tour: Carving Stones for the Ages — Tuff Cultural Relics Protection Solves a World Problem
summary_en: The segment reports on Chinese conservation efforts at the Chengde Mountain Resort and surrounding temples, a World Heritage Site in Hebei, where tuff stone relics have suffered weathering and freeze-thaw damage for over 300 years. Since 2011 the Chinese Academy of Cultural Heritage has developed natural calcium carbonate-based repair materials inspired by ancient Liaojiang stone used in Yangshao-period buildings, building a database of over 10,000 color samples and completing rescue conservation of hundreds of precious tuff stone inscriptions, forming a "Chinese experience" for stone relic protection.

title_en: 【Vital China Research Tour】"Accompaniment" Team Accelerates Innovation
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports on Ningbo's Yongjiang Laboratory in Zhejiang, where a cross-disciplinary "accompaniment" team helps researchers assess market demand and commercialize results; researcher Su Hongjiu's nano-silica polishing abrasive reached thousand-ton mass production and entered mainstream domestic semiconductor firms, and the five-year-old lab has incubated 35 tech companies.

title_en: Grassroots Traditional Chinese Medicine Services Upgraded, Bringing Quality Care to Communities
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that localities are implementing the Traditional Chinese Medicine Action Plan of the Health Care Foundation-Strengthening Project, expanding home-visit TCM services for elderly and disabled rural residents and channeling specialist expertise into urban communities. By the end of 2025, China had 2,238 county-level TCM hospitals, TCM clinics covered nearly 98% of grassroots medical institutions, and 99% of township health centers and community health service centers could provide TCM services.

title_en: Fishing Season Opens Today in South China Sea and Parts of East China Sea
summary_en: At noon on August 16, the three-and-a-half-month summer fishing moratorium in the South China Sea ended, and fishing opened in China's South China Sea waters and parts of the East China Sea. About 32,000 fishing boats in Guangdong and more than 29,000 in Hainan set out in batches, with law-enforcement vessels escorting them through 65 key waterways, while Qiongzhou Strait passenger-roll-on/roll-off service was temporarily suspended from 17:00 today to 5:30 the next day to ensure maritime traffic safety.

title_en: Henan, Jiangsu and Other Regions Intensify Flood Control and Disaster Relief Work
summary_en: Henan and Jiangsu are stepping up flood control and disaster relief amid continuous heavy rainfall, with breaches in dikes along the Qingyi River in Yanling County, Xuchang, and the Jialu River in Chuanhui District, Zhoukou, successfully sealed after dozens of hours of emergency work. Water levels in the Taihu Lake basin in Jiangsu remain high, with the Pingwang hydrological station on the Taipu River exceeding the guaranteed level at 4.52 meters, as local authorities maintain round-the-clock patrols and emergency response.

title_en: Source Innovation Drives New Momentum for Industrial Development
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that national key laboratories are targeting critical links in industrial chains and applying original research results, including a supercritical CO2 oil-recovery and carbon-storage technology raising recovery rates from 30% to over 50% at major oilfields, and hydrogen-safety technologies such as explosion-proof coatings being deployed at hydrogen stations in Qingdao and Shenzhen. It notes that over 500 laboratories have completed restructuring, basic research funding has grown about 13.6% annually over five years, and central SOE annual basic research investment has exceeded 100 billion yuan.

title_en: Building a Denser Rural Logistics Network to Unleash New Vitality in the Countryside
summary_en: The segment reports that localities across China have continued upgrading rural logistics systems this year, citing Luzhou in Sichuan setting up courier collection points at orchard entrances to shorten lychee cold-chain times, and Pingtang in Guizhou launching 30 dedicated passenger-freight-mail buses; China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing data show rural e-commerce logistics volume rose more than 20% year-on-year in July.

title_en: Chongqing Accelerates Deep Integration of Technological and Industrial Innovation
summary_en: Chongqing is building a full-chain ecosystem for university-industry-research collaboration to match enterprise needs with technological solutions, having introduced 39 high-level new R&D institutions and built 22 national excellence-level smart factories and 10 future factories, with a goal of building 50 national-level science and technology innovation platforms by 2030.

title_en: Comrade Zhu Rongji's Body to Be Cremated on the 18th; Flags to Fly at Half-Mast at Tiananmen and Elsewhere in Mourning
summary_en: The body of Comrade Zhu Rongji, outstanding member of the Communist Party of China, veteran and tested loyal communist fighter, distinguished proletarian revolutionary and statesman, outstanding leader of the Party and the state, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 14th and 15th CPC Central Committees, and former Premier of the State Council, will be cremated in Beijing on the 18th. To mourn Comrade Zhu Rongji, flags will fly at half-mast on the 18th at Tiananmen, Xinhua Gate, the Great Hall of the People, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the capital; at the seats of Party committees and governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government; in the Hong Kong and Macao Special Administrative Regions; at border ports, international sea and air ports, and Chinese embassies and consulates abroad.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Airing Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air episodes 11, 'People's Sentiments,' and 12, 'Song of the Great Way,' tonight (August 16) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast on the science and education channel at 10 p.m.

title_en: Grand gathering commemorating the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth to be held in Beijing on the morning of the 17th; Xi Jinping to attend and deliver an important speech
summary_en: A grand gathering commemorating the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth will be held at 10 a.m. on August 17 at the Great Hall of the People, and Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, state president, and chairman of the Central Military Commission, will attend and deliver an important speech. CCTV and other central media outlets will carry the event live.

title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article on Improving Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief Capacity
summary_en: The 16th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on August 16, carries an article by Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, state president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, titled "Improving Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief Capacity." The article stresses the importance of disaster prevention, mitigation and relief work, calls for shifting disaster governance toward pre-disaster prevention, strengthening response capacity for major and catastrophic disasters, and ensuring responsibility is fulfilled at all levels.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports a magnitude 7.7 earthquake near Indonesia's Flores Island that killed at least 38 people, Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi saying Iran will not extend its ceasefire agreement with the United States, Cuban Foreign Minister Rodríguez condemning U.S. maximum pressure and economic strangulation, a sharp drop in U.S. consumer confidence in August, and record-low river levels in Europe amid ongoing drought.

title_en: International figures criticize Japan for distorting history and accelerating 'remilitarization' and other dangerous moves
summary_en: International figures said the Japanese government has not faced history or reflected on its wartime aggression but has instead continued to expand its military and accelerate a 'remilitarization' process, a dangerous trend that threatens regional and world peace and stability. People from multiple countries said Japan should learn the lessons of World War II history and must not repeat the mistakes of militarism.

title_en: Japanese Citizens Hold Rally Urging Japanese Government to Reflect on Aggression War Crimes
summary_en: On August 15, the 81st anniversary of Japan's announcement of unconditional surrender, Japanese citizens spontaneously held a rally and march in Tokyo urging the Japanese government to face up to its history of aggression and reflect on its war crimes.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: CCTV's news roundup reports that China's railways carried 2.8 billion passengers in the first seven months of 2025, up 4.1% year-on-year and a record high for the period, while trade between the China-CEEC economic cooperation demonstration zone and Central and Eastern European countries reached 37.35 billion yuan, up 4%. It also covers new guidelines on pricing inspection medical services, the China Consumers Association's 2026 green consumption guide, the start of regular seasonal service on a Ningbo-Zhoushan Port China-Europe Arctic container route, and the launch of a CMG film culture carnival in Tianjin.

title_en: News Feature: China, I Will Come Again!
summary_en: The segment reports on the growing popularity of "China travel" among foreign tourists, following Portuguese visitor Anna, on her second trip to China, as she completes departure tax refund procedures at Beijing Capital International Airport after an 11-day study tour in Henan focused on traditional Chinese culture and immersive theater experiences. It highlights how visa-free policies, mobile payments, high-speed rail, and diverse tourism experiences are turning first-time visitors into repeat travelers.

title_en: Localities Innovate to Advance Complete Community Development
summary_en: The segment reports that localities across China are accelerating efforts to fill gaps in community services such as elderly care, childcare, convenience stores, parking and greenery, with more than 780 complete-community projects newly started nationwide by the end of June against a target of about 1,000 this year, adding 1,903 public service facilities, 1,517 commercial service facilities and 6.715 million square meters of public activity space and green areas. It highlights contiguous redevelopment in Nantong, Jiangsu, and a wall-free "block-style" complete community in Wenchong Subdistrict, Huangpu District, Guangzhou, and cites the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development on plans to expand, upgrade and improve complete-community construction.

title_en: Heavy Rain Hits Multiple Regions as Flood Control and Disaster Relief Efforts Intensify
summary_en: CCTV reports that heavy rainfall has struck multiple parts of China, with a 117-meter levee breach on the east bank of the Jialu River in Chuanhui District, Zhoukou, Henan, more than 90 meters sealed as of the afternoon of August 14, while central authorities allocated flood-control supplies and 30 million yuan for post-disaster recovery in Henan. Short-term torrential rain also caused flooding in Changxing County, Zhejiang, prompting evacuations, and the national flood control headquarters raised Jiangsu's emergency response from Level IV to Level III and activated a Level IV response for Zhejiang.

title_en: China Takes Multiple Measures to Accelerate Green and Low-Carbon Development
summary_en: At the 2026 National Ecology Day main event in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia, the National Development and Reform Commission and other departments reported that since 2012 China has supported average annual economic growth of 6.1% with energy consumption growth of 3.4% per year, making it one of the countries with the fastest declines in energy and carbon intensity. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China will carry out carbon-peaking actions, promote integrated conservation of energy, water, grain, land, minerals and materials, and upgrade recycling capacity for used machinery, vehicles and electronics, aiming for the resource-recycling industry's output value to reach 8 trillion yuan by 2030.

title_en: 81st Anniversary of Japan's Unconditional Surrender: Events Held Across China to Remember History and Honor Martyrs
summary_en: On the 81st anniversary of Japan's announcement of unconditional surrender, commemorative and educational events were held across China at war-related memorial sites, including the Museum of the War of Chinese People's Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, the September 18th History Museum in Shenyang, and the Memorial Hall of the Victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression in Zhijiang, Hunan. New historical evidence of Japanese wartime crimes was also made public, including materials on chemical warfare and new documents and testimony concerning Unit 731.

title_en: Focusing Efforts and Working Diligently to Achieve a Good Start for the 15th Five-Year Plan: Beijing Builds a Historic and Cultural City, Integrating Preservation with Development
summary_en: The segment reports that Beijing, in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, is pursuing integrated preservation and development of its historic old city, introducing a "menu-style" renovation model for residents' homes and planning to complete conservation plans for 39 historic and cultural districts while revitalizing cultural relics and linking cultural resources along the central axis and three cultural belts.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air episodes nine, 'Jiuzhou Fangyuan,' and ten, 'Wuzhou Jihui,' tonight (August 15) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel.

title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey: Rule of Law Safeguards Building of a Beautiful China, Laying a Solid Ecological Foundation for the Chinese Nation's Sustainable Development
summary_en: On National Ecology Day (August 15), China's Ecological Environment Code took effect, marking a new stage of codified, systematic governance of ecological and environmental protection. The segment highlights Xi Jinping's guidance on building strict institutions and rule of law for ecological civilization, and reports on river and forest chief systems, the national pollution discharge permit system, central ecological inspections, and ecological damage compensation mechanisms.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Yemen's Houthi armed group said it attacked an Aramco refinery in Saudi Arabia's Jizan region with drones; Brazil launched proceedings under its economic reciprocity law to counter new US tariffs on Brazilian products; a new heatwave hit Europe with over 135 million people facing temperatures above 35°C and wildfires forcing evacuations in Britain, France and Croatia; storms in the US Midwest left over 36 million people under flood warnings; and a train derailed near a station in East Sussex, England, injuring 11 people.

title_en: Iran Says It Will Escalate Conflict If Conditions Not Met; U.S. Says It Can Maintain Naval Blockade Indefinitely
summary_en: An adviser to Iran's Supreme Leader, Mojtaba, said on the 13th that Supreme Leader Mojtaba has made a clear strategic decision to escalate the conflict if Iran's conditions—including a permanent halt to military action against Iran and its regional allies, an end to the naval blockade, war reparations, and the lifting of sanctions—are not met. U.S. Defense Secretary Hegseth said the U.S. military can maintain the naval blockade of Iran "indefinitely," Treasury Secretary Bessent said Washington will take "unprecedented" measures against Iran's economy, and U.S. media reported that U.S. forces have lost at least 45 MQ-9 "Reaper" drones in the conflict, with the USS Washington preparing to deploy to the Middle East to replace the USS Lincoln.

title_en: World 'Comfort Women' Victims Memorial Day Marked with Events in South Korea and the Philippines
summary_en: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung issued a written message at a memorial ceremony in Seoul marking the World 'Comfort Women' Victims Memorial Day, saying the history of the Japanese military's forced recruitment of 'comfort women' must be remembered. In the Philippines, families of victims and civil society groups protested outside the Japanese embassy, calling for justice for the victims and opposing Japan's military expansion.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports the release of the 15th Five-Year Plan for the safety and emergency equipment industry, a 2.4% year-on-year rise in China's July express delivery development index, completion of track-laying on the Xiong'an-Xinzhou high-speed railway, the publication of China's first ISO international standard in the fusion fueling field, and an upcoming High-End Interview with Fields Medal winner Martin Hairer.

title_en: China's Bird Protection Achieves Notable Results
summary_en: China's National Forestry and Grassland Administration released data showing notable progress in bird protection, with 1,140 important habitats identified along migratory bird flyways and populations of 19 nationally protected species such as the crested ibis, Saunders's gull, and brown eared pheasant stable or growing. Synchronized monitoring this winter recorded 6.324 million waterbirds of 167 species, up 158.9% from 2.443 million in 2016 and the highest total recorded to date.

title_en: Policy Measures Boost Inbound Consumption as Departure Tax Refunds Grow Significantly in Many Regions
summary_en: One month after the launch of the upgraded "2.0" departure tax refund policy, applications and refund amounts have risen sharply across China, with Hangzhou's airport seeing applications more than triple year-on-year in July, Guangzhou customs verifying over 100 million yuan in refund applications (up about 1.5 times), Sichuan's application volume up 2.4 times, and Beijing's applications up 516.31% in the first seven months of the year.

title_en: Persistent Rainfall Across Multiple Regions; Flood Control and Disaster Relief Efforts Intensify
summary_en: CCTV reports that heavy rain continues to affect many parts of China, with flood control and rescue work underway, including the evacuation of 455 people after a dike breach on the Jialu River in Zhoukou, Henan, and the relocation of over 2,000 people following a breach on the Beiru River in Jiaxian, Pingdingshan. The Ministry of Water Resources activated a major flood and drought disaster response mechanism, and central authorities allocated 30,000 relief items and 80 million yuan in emergency funds to support Henan, Hubei, and Anhui.

title_en: Financial aggregates grow reasonably in first seven months; social financing environment remains accommodative
summary_en: CCTV reports that People's Bank of China data show M2 stood at 355.51 trillion yuan at end-July 2026, up 7.7% year on year, and the stock of social financing reached 463.27 trillion yuan, up 7.4%, with both outpacing nominal GDP growth. Outstanding RMB loans rose 5.1% to 282.29 trillion yuan, while weighted average rates on new corporate loans were slightly below 3.0% and on new personal housing loans about 3.1%.

title_en: Central Propaganda Department and Other Departments Jointly Issue Notice Requiring Study and Publicity of Ecological Environment Code
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The Central Propaganda Department and 18 other departments and units jointly issued a notice deploying study and publicity work for the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China, the country's second law named a "code" after the Civil Code. The notice calls for using the August 15 National Ecology Day and the code's formal implementation as focal points for public outreach and themed activities to raise ecological and legal awareness among officials and the public.

title_en: Jiangsu Accelerates Intelligent Manufacturing by Clearing AI-Enablement Bottlenecks
summary_en: Jiangsu, a major manufacturing province, is helping enterprises overcome obstacles to AI-enabled upgrading, including through Kunshan's coordination group that has reviewed over 170 application scenarios and matched firms with AI partners. The province's "AI + Manufacturing" plan aims for more than 20% AI scenario coverage in about 5,000 advanced-level smart factories by 2027.

title_en: Establishing and Practicing a Correct View of Political Achievements: Promoting Learning Through Action and Deepening Education and Learning
summary_en: The segment reports on how Xishuangbanna in Yunnan and Heihe in Heilongjiang have combined study, inspection, and rectification in the education campaign on establishing a correct view of political achievements, with Xishuangbanna organizing officials to visit villages and resolve over 2,700 public concerns such as education, healthcare, and elderly care, and Heihe providing targeted support to key cultural tourism enterprises amid rising cross-border passenger flows.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air episodes seven, 'True Colors in the Storm,' and eight, 'A New Chapter for Elite Troops,' tonight (August 14) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Dividing the 'Cake' to Enrich and Benefit the People — Zhejiang Solidly Advances Construction of Common Prosperity Demonstration Zone
summary_en: The segment reports on Zhejiang's progress in building its common prosperity demonstration zone over the past five-plus years, including mobile medical services reaching mountainous villages, expanded rural infrastructure and public services, and integrated elderly care and childcare programs. It notes that 96 provincial-level basic public service standards now apply equally in urban and rural areas, and that Zhejiang aims to basically complete a high-quality development and high-quality life pilot zone by 2030.

title_en: At Xi Jinping's invitation, Ecuadorian President to visit China
summary_en: At the invitation of President Xi Jinping, President Daniel Roy-Gilchrist Noboa Azín of the Republic of Ecuador will pay a state visit to China from August 16 to 23.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Russian President Vladimir Putin visited the disputed Southern Kuril Islands for the first time, drawing a strong protest from Japan, and also covers the U.S. strategic petroleum reserve falling below 300 million barrels, a U.S. Apache helicopter crash in Texas, ongoing eruptions of Italy's Mount Etna affecting flights, and drought water restrictions across mainland France.

title_en: Search and Rescue Continues After Colombia Earthquake; Country Enters Economic State of Emergency
summary_en: Colombian President Juan Manuel Santos said on the 12th that the strong earthquake that struck the country on the 10th had killed 265 people, injured 3,494 and destroyed more than 11,000 homes, with over 50,000 homes damaged to varying degrees; he also declared a state of economic emergency. Search and rescue and damage assessment are continuing, with medical workers and volunteers setting up temporary medical points near the rubble in the hard-hit cities of Cali and Pereira.

title_en: South Korean Civic Groups Hold Commemoration for 'Comfort Women' Victims
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): South Korean civic groups held a protest rally on the 12th in front of the Japanese embassy in Seoul, calling on the Japanese government to face history squarely, reflect on its war crimes, and formally apologize and pay compensation over the 'comfort women' issue.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that market regulators handled over 23,000 cases of food additive misuse since April last year, that the first section of the Lianyungang–Yizheng crude oil pipeline entered operation, that the Shiziyang Bridge completed its anchorage main structure, that the Three Gorges hub's throughput reached 100 million tons this year, that Suzhou Industrial Park's foreign trade exceeded 1 trillion yuan in the first seven months, and that summer box office takings surpassed 9.1 billion yuan with record admissions and screenings.

title_en: China's Asian Elephant Population Grows Against Global Trend
summary_en: CCTV reports that monitoring data from the National Forestry and Grassland Administration show China's wild Asian elephant population has risen to nearly 400, up from about 150 in the 1980s, even as global numbers decline. The segment notes that 11 nature reserves have been established along with habitat and food-source bases in Yunnan, and that the Xishuangbanna rescue and breeding center has taken in over 30 wild elephants, including a young male released back into the wild.

title_en: National Mobile Medical Teams Provide On-Site Assistance, Bringing Quality Care to Central and Western County-Level Areas
summary_en: Under a regular mobile medical program by the National Health Commission and the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, 89 national medical teams have been formed this year to provide on-site assistance at the grassroots level, with teams dispatched to county-level areas in central and western China during the summer to bring national-level quality medical resources to residents' doorsteps. Over the past 15 years, 342 national mobile medical teams have been sent to train grassroots medical personnel through teaching rounds and lectures, leaving behind a medical team that cannot be taken away.

title_en: Rain Continues Across Central and Eastern China; Regions and Departments Respond with Multiple Measures
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that sustained rainfall has affected parts of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, Henan, Hubei and Anhui, prompting Henan to activate the Nihewa flood storage and detention area in Wuyang County, Luoyang, where 4,567 people in 10 villages were evacuated in advance, and Anhui to divert Ying River floodwater via the Cihuaixin artificial channel.
