The National Disaster Prevention and Relief Office and Ministry of Emergency Management, together with the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration, allocated 20,000 central relief items to Henan and Hebei, while the meteorological department warned of elevated risks of flash floods, geological disasters and urban waterlogging.

title_en: China Accelerates Construction of Next-Generation Communications Networks
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that China is accelerating next-generation communications infrastructure, including 136 10-gigabit optical network pilot projects launched since 2025, upgrades of 5G base stations to 5G-A, a Ministry of Industry and Information Technology pilot program for 6G innovation targeting self-developed 6G technical solutions by 2029, and faster satellite internet deployment with low-orbit constellations and direct-to-handset satellite technology.

title_en: China's normalized assistance achieves a steady start
summary_en: CCTV reports that this year, the first year of China's normalized assistance program, a policy system covering monitoring and assistance plus industrial and employment assistance has been basically established to prevent any large-scale return to poverty; monitoring mechanisms are operating effectively, industrial assistance is expanding, and the central government has allocated 177 billion yuan in normalized assistance funds, with more than 32 million people lifted out of poverty now employed.

title_en: Financial Services for the Real Economy Continue to Improve in Quality and Efficiency
summary_en: The People's Bank of China reported that its moderately loose monetary policy has continued to take effect this year, with social financing conditions relatively accommodative and financial services to the real economy steadily improving; by end-June, lending to technology, green, inclusive, elderly care, and digital economy sectors continued to grow faster than total loans, and the weighted average interest rate on new loans to small and medium-sized private enterprises fell 40 basis points year-on-year, benefiting about 2.5 million market entities. In the next stage, the PBOC said it will use and adjust monetary policy tools as appropriate to keep liquidity ample, strengthen coordination with fiscal policy, and step up countercyclical adjustment to expand domestic demand and optimize supply.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: China Comprehensively Advances the Building of a Beautiful China
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on August 13, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment reported continued improvement in China's environmental quality in the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, including a 6.2% year-on-year drop in average PM2.5 concentration and a 3.9 percentage point rise in the share of days with good air quality over the first seven months. It also outlined targets for 2030, including reducing national PM2.5 concentration to below 27 micrograms per cubic meter, raising the share of good-quality surface water to 85%, completing environmental improvement in 80,000 administrative villages, and supporting around 200 cities in building "zero-waste cities."

title_en: Tianjin Continues to Strengthen Port Support and Promote Integrated Port-Industry-City Development
summary_en: Tianjin is leveraging its port advantages to develop modern shipping services and integrate port, industry, and city development under the 15th Five-Year Plan, with the city's port container routes reaching 152 and exports totaling 226.6 billion yuan in the first half of the year, up 9.2 percent year-on-year. The city's 15th Five-Year Plan for integrated port-industry-city development, released in May, targets 600 billion yuan in total output value for five major port-adjacent industries in Binhai New Area by 2030.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air its fifth episode, 'Strategy for Rejuvenating the Nation,' and sixth episode, 'Coordinating the Overall Situation,' tonight (August 13) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Making the 'Cake' Bigger and Narrowing Gaps — Zhejiang Solidly Advances Construction of Common Prosperity Demonstration Zone
summary_en: The segment reports on Zhejiang's progress in building the common prosperity demonstration zone since May 2021, highlighting upgraded mountain-sea cooperation pairing mechanisms, the 'Ten Thousand Villages' project's role in rural integration, and a narrowing urban-rural income ratio from 1.96 to 1.81, with rural per capita disposable income reaching 27,555 yuan in the first half of the year, up 6.0 percent year-on-year.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Yemen's Houthi armed group claimed attacks with missiles and drones on Saudi-linked targets in Taiz and Marib provinces and on a vessel in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, with casualties; that Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi visited Iran and met President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, while Defense Minister Khawaja Asif said the US and Iran are close to some agreement; and that the DRC's current Ebola outbreak has surpassed 2,000 deaths among nearly 4,400 confirmed cases.

title_en: Severe Earthquake Disaster in Colombia; Rescue Efforts Intensify
summary_en: A magnitude-7.5 earthquake in northwestern Colombia has killed 188 people and injured 1,677, according to statistics released on the 11th by the Colombian Association of Capital Cities; rescue operations are being stepped up, and UN Secretary-General António Guterres said in a statement issued through Deputy Spokesperson Farhan Haq that the United Nations is in close contact with the Colombian government and supports its relief work, while the World Food Programme has launched assistance at Colombia's request.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China has allocated 3.196 billion yuan in central funds to drainage capacity projects in 13 key regions, that the Yellow River has maintained continuous flow for 27 years, and that China delivered the world's largest multi-purpose heavy-lift vessel. It also covers the C919's first international commercial route (Beijing–Ulaanbaatar) and the departure of the Navy's 49th escort task force for the Gulf of Aden and Somali waters.

title_en: National Vegetable Supply Situation Generally Stable
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's in-field vegetable acreage has reached 106 million mu, with coordinated scheduling and staggered harvests ensuring ample market supply; highland and northern summer-autumn vegetable areas are the main suppliers as southern open-field growth slows due to sustained high temperatures, and major supermarkets and wholesale markets are broadening procurement channels to keep prices stable and meet residents' daily needs.

title_en: Various Regions and Departments Actively Respond to Severe Rainstorms
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that under the influence of the residual circulation of Typhoon Dolphin, heavy rainfall has hit central and eastern China, prompting local governments and departments to take measures including flood rescue in Yuzhou, Henan, drainage operations and train suspensions in Zhengzhou, evacuation of over 14,100 people in Xiangyang, Hubei, and emergency preparations in Beijing, while the national flood control emergency response for Henan was raised from Level IV to Level III.

title_en: Nuclear Power Construction Steadily Advances, Total Installed Capacity Ranks First in the World
summary_en: CCTV reports that China has 57 approved nuclear power units under construction, accounting for more than half the global total, with combined installed capacity of operating and approved units reaching 135 million kilowatts, the world's largest. In late July, eight more units were newly approved, the first batch of nuclear projects approved during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, as China continues its principle of "active, safe and orderly development" and steadily builds the eastern coastal nuclear power belt.

title_en: China's Auto Exports Continue Strong Growth Momentum
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports, citing the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, that China's auto exports reached 1.043 million vehicles in July, up 81.3% year-on-year, with new energy vehicle exports at 553,000 units, up 145.5%, marking the second consecutive month above one million vehicles and NEVs accounting for over 50% of exports for two straight months. The association attributes the growth to China's complete auto supply chain and advances in intelligent vehicle technology.

title_en: Obituary from the CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council and CPPCC National Committee: Comrade Zhu Rongji Passes Away
summary_en: The segment announces the death of former Premier Zhu Rongji, a Standing Committee member of the 14th and 15th CPC Central Committees Political Bureau, who died in Beijing on August 12, 2026, at age 98 after illness, and reviews his career from Tsinghua University and the State Planning Commission through his tenure as Shanghai party secretary, vice premier and premier (1998-2003), citing his roles in fiscal, financial and state-owned enterprise reform, WTO accession negotiations and macroeconomic management during the Asian financial crisis.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Airing Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air its third episode, 'Taking Command in Crisis,' and fourth episode, 'Major Breakthroughs,' tonight (August 12) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel.

title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey: Comprehensive Multimodal Transport Network Construction Accelerates Toward Western China's Interior
summary_en: CCTV reports that, in the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, China is accelerating construction of its comprehensive multimodal transport network toward western regions, with the Pinglu Canal beginning full-line live vessel trials on August 12 ahead of its September opening as a key project of the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor. The segment cites Xi Jinping's directives on western development and notes that western railway mileage rose from 59,100 to 67,300 kilometers over five years, with highway and airport connectivity also expanding.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on the UN Yemen envoy's warning that escalating tensions could plunge Yemen back into full-scale conflict, Israeli settler violence in the West Bank surging about 63% in the first half of the year, the yen falling to the 159-per-dollar range, and three continental football confederations criticizing FIFA over the proposed sale of World Cup-related rights.

title_en: Data shows US average temperature in July hit record high
summary_en: Citing National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration data released on the 10th, the segment reports that the US average temperature in July reached a record high of about 24.94 degrees Celsius, with July precipitation the third lowest on record and roughly half the country in drought by early August; it also covers drought and wildfires across Europe, including the UK, France, Slovakia and Spain.

title_en: US Claims Full Control of Strait of Hormuz; Iran Criticizes US Blockade for Hindering Restoration of Navigation
summary_en: US President Trump said the US has "100 percent" control of the Strait of Hormuz and has cleared mines throughout it, and that he has directed US negotiators to include a demand for compensation from Iran in all future talks; Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei said the US naval blockade and military actions are the main obstacle to fully restoring safe navigation through the strait. Separately, Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba signed orders reshuffling senior military posts, including naming Major General Ali Abdollahi as armed forces chief of staff and Ahmad Vahidi as commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, while Iranian President Pezeshkian said Mojtaba is in "good health" after a roughly seven-hour meeting.

title_en: Magnitude 7.5 Earthquake Strikes Colombia, Country Enters "State of National Disaster"
summary_en: A magnitude 7.5 earthquake struck northwestern Colombia, killing 132 people and injuring 570, with 32 cities severely affected as the country declared a "state of national disaster." President Juan Manuel Santos said the top priority is rescuing people trapped in the rubble.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's large internet companies generated over 1 trillion yuan in internet business revenue in the first half of 2026, up 10.1% year on year, and that the country will establish a national master catalog of immovable cultural relics under its 15th Five-Year Plan for cultural heritage. It also covers the release of 338 national standards, a nationwide anti-organized-crime operation in which more than 8,200 suspects were detained, 29.9% growth in import-export value via the China-Laos Railway in the first seven months, the hoisting of the world's first 500-megawatt Pelton turbine rotor at the Zhala hydropower station in Tibet, and the announcement of the 38th Hundred Flowers Film Awards in Beijing.

title_en: [Cultural China Tour] Ancient Scripts Project Unveils the Veil of Remote Antiquity
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's major cultural project on ancient scripts and the transmission of Chinese civilization has entered the final stage of its first phase, with achievements including the largest catalog of oracle bone inscriptions and the joining of over 1,200 newly matched fragments; the project, launched in 2020 by eight departments including the Central Propaganda Department and Ministry of Education with 18 institutions such as Tsinghua University, the Chinese Academy of History and the National Museum, has supported about 300 research projects, trained over 1,300 students and published more than 360 works, and its next phase will focus on the digital repatriation of ancient script materials held overseas and building a large model for ancient scripts.

title_en: Party Flag Flies High at the Grassroots: Warm Guardianship in the Storm
summary_en: CCTV News reports that under the influence of Typhoon Dolphin, parts of Zhejiang suffered sustained heavy rainfall, and Party members and officials rushed to the front lines to prevent flooding and eliminate dangers, including a village official who dove into muddy water to clear a blocked drainage outlet in Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, and emergency teams in Xiangshan County, Ningbo, who patrolled aquaculture areas every three hours to protect fish farmers.

title_en: Regions and Departments Actively Respond to Impact of Typhoon Baihaitun
summary_en: Heavy rain from Typhoon Baihaitun caused flooding and disruptions across Jiangsu, Anhui, Hubei, Henan and Zhejiang, prompting emergency drainage, evacuations and traffic controls; the NDRC allocated 200 million yuan for post-disaster recovery in Zhejiang, and the national flood control headquarters launched a Level IV flood response for Beijing and Tianjin.

title_en: China to Accelerate Building of a Modern Coal Industry System
summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration jointly released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development, which calls for optimizing coal development layout, raising access standards for coal resource development, phasing out outdated and ineffective capacity, and promoting clean and efficient coal use. By 2030, the share of capacity from large modern coal mines is to reach 87 percent and the share from intelligent coal mines 75 percent, with coalbed methane output reaching 26 billion cubic meters and a modern coal industry system basically in place.

title_en: China's Ecological Quality to Improve Steadily During 15th Five-Year Plan Period
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that the Ministry of Ecology and Environment has issued the "15th Five-Year Plan" Ecological Protection Plan, which aims by 2030 to optimize ecological spatial patterns, consolidate the national ecological security barrier system, expand the protected areas system centered on national parks, and strengthen biodiversity conservation. Targets include protected natural areas covering no less than 18% of land area, a soil and water conservation rate above 74%, and forest coverage reaching 25.8%.

title_en: Locales Seize Farming Season to Carry Out Field Management
summary_en: The segment reports that regions across China are seizing the farming season to conduct field management and crop protection, including pest and disease monitoring for rice in Heilongjiang and Jilin, water-fertilizer integration and drone spraying for corn in Hebei and Shaanxi, and mechanized harvesting of rice in Sichuan and Guizhou.

title_en: Documentary Film 'Jiang Zemin' Begins Airing Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, a twelve-part documentary film 'Jiang Zemin,' co-produced by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Institute of Party History and Literature of the CPC Central Committee, the National Radio and Television Administration, and China Media Group, premieres tonight (August 11) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel and rebroadcasts at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel. The film reviews Jiang Zemin's more than 70-year revolutionary career and highlights his achievements and lofty style; the first episode, 'Tempered Through Storms,' and the second, 'Daring to Explore,' air today.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Weaving a Denser and Warmer Social Security Safety Net
summary_en: The segment reports on China's efforts to strengthen its social security system, citing Xi Jinping's statements on social security as a basic institutional safeguard for livelihoods and social fairness, and highlighting reforms including Zhejiang's big-assistance information platform that shifts from "people seeking policies" to "policies seeking people," expanded occupational injury protection for new employment forms, the first specialized social assistance law, and the nationwide rollout of long-term care insurance as a "sixth insurance."

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Message of Condolence to Colombian President over Strong Earthquake in Colombia
summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence to Colombian President Draes Pulea (per the broadcast) over a strong earthquake in Colombia that caused serious casualties and property losses, expressing deep mourning for the victims and sincere sympathy to the bereaved families and the injured, and voicing confidence that under the Colombian government led by President Draes Pulea the Colombian people will overcome the disaster and rebuild their homes.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that U.S. media say President Trump favors economic pressure over new military action against Iran, and that Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met with Supreme Leader Mojtaba. It also covers Russian and Ukrainian claims of strikes and casualties, Danish kayak protests in Copenhagen supporting Greenland against U.S. pressure, and wildfires in Canada, Albania and Spain.

title_en: Houthi Armed Forces Claim Attacks on Yemeni Government Forces Targets and Saudi Refinery
summary_en: Yemen's Houthi armed forces said on August 9 that they used missiles and drones to attack a Yemeni government forces assembly point and weapons depot at Mocha Port on the Red Sea coast in Taiz Province, and Yemeni government forces said on August 10 that the attacks killed at least 7 people and injured 30. The Houthis also said they struck a Saudi Aramco refinery with drones in response to recent Saudi drone incursions into Yemeni airspace, while Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry reported a fire at an Aramco refinery facility in Jizan with no casualties but did not state the cause.

title_en: Israeli Prime Minister Says He Rejects US-Backed Gaza Peace Plan; US Media Says White House 'Does Not Care'
summary_en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on the 9th that Israel rejects the Gaza peace plan proposed by the US-initiated 'Board of Peace,' insisting that Hamas must genuinely disarm, including heavy and light weapons, or Israeli forces will not withdraw from the Gaza Strip. US media, citing a senior US official, reported that the White House 'does not care' about Netanyahu's remarks and views them as a 'political need' related to Israel's election.

title_en: Japanese citizens hold rallies protesting the dangerous moves of the Takaichi administration to expand the military and amend the constitution
summary_en: On the 81st anniversary of the Nagasaki atomic bombing, some Japanese citizens held a rally in Nagasaki on the 9th to protest the dangerous moves by the government of Sanae Takaichi to expand the military and amend the constitution. In Tokyo, some Japanese citizens also held a protest the same day, demanding that the Japanese government face up to its history of aggression and uphold peace.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China has built about 8 million tons of green fuel production capacity as of end-2025, that cumulative inbound and outbound vehicle crossings at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Zhuhai port have surpassed 25 million, that China's 16th Arctic Ocean expedition is conducting ice station surveys with the Xuelong and Xuelong 2 vessels, and that endangered forest musk deer were filmed in Wuxi County, Chongqing.
